stories.title: 'Sister warned him not to lose career for love':Moradabad man stabbed sister 84 times for girl who was only an online love
stories.summary: In Moradabad, the engineer brother, Hardik, who stabbed his engineer sister 84 times and killed her, has now been sent to jail. During police questioning, he kept making confused statements. He said his Muslim girlfriend was tortured by her family and that her life was ruined because of him. What is shocking is that Hardik (25), who brutally killed his twin sister Himshikha (25) and carried out a deadly attack on his mother for the girl, had never even met her. It was only an online relationship. He used to talk to his girlfriend only on Instagram. CO Civil Lines Kuldeep Kumar Gupta said - During interrogation, Hardik revealed that he had been in a relationship with a Muslim girl from Pune for about one and a half years. They were in touch only through Instagram. They would talk for hours. They had even taken vows to live and die together on Instagram. The police investigation so far has revealed that Hardik wanted to marry his online girlfriend. However, his sister and mother advised him not to be crazy in love, saying this is the age to build a career. Meanwhile, the girlfriend's family also started troubling her. They often started beating her. Police are investigating about the girlfriend. 'Mother was worried alone, so I thought I would kill her' SP City Ranvijay Singh said - After Hardik's arrest, several rounds of interrogation were conducted to understand the motive for murder. However, his behavior appeared psychotic. When asked why he killed his sister, he said, ‘She wanted to control my personal life’. She repeatedly advised me to leave the girl and focus on my career. I tried explaining to her many times to leave me alone, but she wouldn't listen. Sister kept saying what have you become because of one girl. You've even left your job and are always caught up with her. Fed up with my sister's advice and taunts, I killed her. When he was asked why he tried to kill his mother? Hardik said that I thought that after killing my sister, I would go to jail. Mother would be left alone. She would be troubled in that case. So I thought I should kill my mother too. Murdered with vegetable cutting knife Hardik killed his sister with a vegetable cutting knife. After interrogation, the police recovered the knife. Later, he was produced in court, from where he was sent to jail. Meanwhile, the sister's postmortem report came out. A total of 84 wounds were found on Himshikha's body. Heart, liver, kidneys, and ribs were all perforated. There were also 4 knife wounds on the neck. Even her limbs, shoulders, and face had knife wounds. Hardik killed his own twin sister Himshikha with such cruelty and brutality that even the postmortem team was shocked. After the postmortem, Himshikha's dead body was cremated by her maternal uncle Deepu. Police had called relatives by sending information to Badaun. Due to the mother being hospitalized, she could not even see her daughter for the last time. Mother sobbing in hospital, daughter murdered, son sent to jail Mother Neelima is hospitalized after being injured by her son. Hardik had stabbed his mother 6 times with a knife, but Neelima was fortunate to survive. Now her condition is out of danger. In one stroke, Neelima's entire world has been destroyed. Her daughter is dead. Her son is in jail. Thinking about all this, Neelima keeps breaking down in tears on the hospital bed. After killing sister, he told mother, ‘Want to give you a surprise, come home’ According to police, Neelima works as an Assistant Manager at an insurance company office on Delhi Road in Moradabad. On Friday, after killing his sister at home, Hardik went to the office to call his mother. He said, ‘Mom, come home, I want to give you a surprise’. He brought his mother home by car. As soon as the mother opened the gate of the house, blood was spread throughout the house. The blood-soaked, dead body of daughter Himshikha was lying on the bed in the room. She screamed at this. Before Neelima could recover, Hardik launched multiple knife attacks on her as well. Both siblings lived in Gurgaon, brother had quit his job Himshikha and Hardik were twins. After completing engineering, both worked at an IT company in Gurgaon. Himshikha was pursuing an MBA alongside her job. While Hardik also worked at a company for one and a half years. After falling in love with a Gurgaon girl on Instagram, he quit his job and started uploading content on YouTube. Neelima had settled in Moradabad after coming from Badaun According to police, Neelima originally belonged to Jogipur in Badaun. About 30 years ago, she and her husband settled in Moradabad. Around 10 years ago, she separated from her husband. After that, she started living in a rented house in Buddhi Vihar. She educated her children and made them capable of getting jobs.

stories.title: Varanasi woman turns cow dung into livelihood for thousands:Rita Tiwari trains nearly 6,000 women; helps them earn and live with dignity
stories.summary: When intentions are as strong as steel, and the goal is social welfare, even seemingly ordinary resources become a means of extraordinary change. 50-year-old Rita Tiwari, a resident of Tarna Yamuna Nagar Colony in Shivpur police station area of Varanasi district, Uttar Pradesh, has proven this to be true. Today, on the auspicious occasion of International Women's Day, Rita Tiwari's story serves as a beacon for millions of women who dream of creating their own identity and becoming self-reliant. Rita Tiwari has transformed cow dung from mere 'waste' into the foundation of an 'economy'. Today, under her guidance, thousands of women in Varanasi are not only supporting their households but also living with dignity in society by making incense sticks, lamps, statues, and planters from cow dung. The idea of 'empowerment' emerged during crisis Rita Tiwari shares that she has been involved in cow service and social work for the past two decades. However, the major change in her life and working style came during the lockdown imposed during the COVID-19 pandemic. Rita explains that when she would go to poor and Dalit settlements to distribute food, she witnessed the helplessness of women there very closely. Due to financial constraints, these women were struggling even for their children's basic needs. This is where Rita had the idea that these women need not just donations, but work. She contacted the Cow Science and Research Center, Nagpur, and learned the intricacies of making valuable products from cow dung. After training, she ordered molds for making incense sticks, statues, and planters, and began her mission. The beginning was small, but the goal was big. Gradually, women kept joining, and today it has become a caravan. Currently, around 6 thousand women from all eight blocks of Varanasi, like Harhua, Cholapur, Chiraigaon, Badagaon, Pindra, Sevapuri, Araji Line, and Kashi Vidyapeeth have joined this institution.

stories.title: Two women perform last rites for the abandoned in UP:Gorakhpur's 'Pushpalata' Muzaffarnagar's 'Shalu' fulfills duty of a son
stories.summary: Every person desires that when they leave this world, they should be carried by their loved ones. The last rites should be performed with full respect and proper rituals. But not everyone is destined for this. Many people pass away in anonymity, with no one to claim their bodies. Two UP women have taken up the responsibility of giving final farewell to such unclaimed bodies. These women are- Pushpalata Singh from Gorakhpur and Shalu Saini from Muzaffarnagar. On International Women's Day, read the story of these two women of how they chose to step away from social traditions and take up this responsibility, and what inspired them to dedicate themselves to this service. An Ailing Elderly Man Changed Her Life Pushpalata who is a resident of Gorakhpur said that about three years ago she saw an elderly man in a very sick condition by the roadside. She did not leave him in that state. Instead, she brought him home with her and arranged treatment for him. She continued his treatment for nearly a year. Later, the elderly man passed away. She herself performed his last rites and this was the moment when the thought came to her mind that those who have no one in this world also deserve a dignified farewell. From then on, she resolved to perform the last rites of unclaimed bodies. Support for poor and helpless people Pushpalata does not limit herself only to performing the last rites of unclaimed bodies. If she finds any helpless or sick person on the road, she takes care of them and, if necessary, even brings them home with her. 5 thousand people joined, 40 people active She said, “Around 5 thousand people have joined my campaign so far. However, only about 35 to 40 people actively work among them”. Police hands over bodies after legal process According to Pushpalata, bodies that have no claimants are handed over to her by the police after the legal formalities are completed. She then prepares for the last rites with full respect. First, she cleans the body and prepares it properly, and then takes it to the cremation ground located on the banks of the Rapti River. There, she personally carries the body to the funeral pyre and completes the entire ritual by lighting the pyre herself. If someone later gets information about their family member and their last rites have been performed by them, they can also receive the ashes. Pledge to donate own body and organs With this same spirit of humanity, Pushpalata has taken another big decision in her life. She has pledged to donate her body and organs while alive. She said that when she is no longer in this world, what could be more satisfying than having her body or organs be useful for someone in need. Her father is no longer in this world, but even when he was alive, he never opposed this decision. Currently, Pushpalata lives alone in her father's house. More than 250 bodies cremated so far Pushaplata says that in 2025, she performed the last rites of 225 bodies. From the beginning of 2026 until now, she has performed the last rites of more than 50 unclaimed bodies. Now read the story of Shalu Saini from Muzaffarnagar, who has performed the last rites of more than 6,000 bodies from the Covid period until now. Where did the inspiration to perform last rites of dead bodies come from Shalu Saini who is a resident of Muzaffarnagar shares that her social service journey began with a sudden incident. She said, “Dead bodies would often flow into the Ganges river in the Shukratal area. This area is considered a Khadar region, which is why bodies flowing in the river were often found here”. One such day when she saw a body that had flowed into the Ganges, a question arose in her mind about who would perform the last rites of these people. From that moment, she decided to give such bodies a respectful final farewell. Many bodies washed away in Kedarnath floods She said that when disaster struck Kedarnath in 2013, people were washed away to different places. During that time, some bodies arrived in their area. People from her organization informed her about it, then she arranged for their last rites. Performing last rites continuously since Covid period She added, “When the Covid pandemic period came, I started this service work continuously”. She said, “During Covid, the most painful time was when many families were afraid to come near or touch the bodies of their own people. The families who worked hard their whole lives for their loved ones, distanced themselves after death”. She further stated, “At that time, there were very few unclaimed bodies, but now they also receive people who don't have money for last rites or who live in slums”. According to Shalu, from the time of Covid until now, she has performed the last rites of more than 6,000 bodies. Collects expenses with help from friends Regarding the expenses incurred in funeral services, she explained, “I collect money with help of my friends and companions. The work continues with whatever support I receive”. Runs home and service through street vending To support her family, she operates a cart selling clothes and fast food at Jhansi ki Rani Chowk. From this income, she manages both her children's expenses and her social service work. Also started an old age home She said that she had a plot in South Krishna Puri area, where she started an old age home named 'Krantikari Shalu Saini'. Arrangements are being made here to house helpless elderly people. Takes ashes to Haridwar every month She stated that she takes the ashes of the bodies whose last rites she performs to Haridwar every month and immerses them in the Ganges. Peace prayers are also conducted there. Sons Also Help She said that her children are the biggest support in her life. They give her full support and never stop her from doing this work. When she is out of town, her 23-year-old son Sumit Saini also fulfills this responsibility and performs the last rites when needed.

stories.title: LKG student kidnapped in front of grandfather in Prayagraj:2 criminals flee after dragging child into car
stories.summary: On Saturday, an LKG student was kidnapped in broad daylight in Prayagraj. The student was returning home from school. As soon as he got out of the school van, two criminals pulled him into a car and fled. This kidnapping happened in front of the child's grandfather. He had come to receive him. He was standing just a short distance away. The family's financial condition is not good. The child's father works as a security guard in Mumbai. The mother is in a terrible state, crying continuously. No ransom call has been received yet. Additional Police Commissioner Dr. Ajay Pal Sharma and Yamunapar DCP Vivek Chandra Yadav reached the spot. Both officers reprimanded Manda police station SHO Anil Kumar Verma. Ajay Pal has assured the recovery of the student within 24 hours. Police teams are engaged in searching for the kidnappers. Now read the complete incident in sequence... School is 15 km away from home The incident occurred around 4 PM on Saturday evening in Sarai Kala village of Manda. Om Prakash Sharma from the village works as a security guard in Mumbai. His wife, two children, and his father, Nageshwar, live in the village. Among Om Prakash's two children, Prateek is the elder one, 6 years old. He has a younger sister who is 3-years-old. Prateek studies in LKG at Sonar Ka Tara School located in Ramnagar, Meja. The school is about 15 km away from home, and he travels by van. The van drops him about 150 meters away from his house, from where his grandfather picks him up and drops him off. Criminals came in white Alto car Grandfather Nageshwar said - Prateek returns home from school around 4 PM every evening. On Saturday evening, too, I was going to pick him up at the same time. I was about 20 steps away from the point where the school van drops off Prateek. Just then, a white Alto car came and stopped. Two people were sitting in it. One came out of the car and started asking me for directions. At that moment, the van arrived. He explained that as soon as Prateek got out of the van, the person who was asking me for directions quickly ran towards the child. Before I could understand anything, his accomplice moved the car forward, and in the next moment, they pulled Prateek into the car and fled with their companion. I ran after them but couldn't reach the car. Grandfather said - Couldn't see the car number Police arrived after being informed about this incident that occurred in broad daylight. During questioning, the grandfather said that everything happened so quickly that he couldn't see the car number. He had never seen either of the criminals before. When police questioned the villagers, they learned that the car went towards Aunta village. Police set up checkpoints on all nearby roads, but so far no trace of the kidnappers, and the child has not been found. DCP Yamunanagar Vivek Chandra Yadav said, So far in the questioning, the family has not mentioned any enmity. The family's financial condition is not very good. Till now, no calls have been received by the family members. Investigation is being conducted on every point. Akhilesh Yadav demands safe return of the child home

stories.title: YouTuber Anurag Dobhal crashes car during Instagram Live:‘UK07 Rider’ survives high-speed ‘final drive’ in apparent 'suicide' bid
stories.summary: Famous YouTuber from Dehradun Anurag Dobhal allegedly attempted suicide during an Instagram live on Saturday evening. Around 7 PM, he went live while driving his car on the Meerut highway in Uttar Pradesh. During the live session, he appeared emotional and said, “Let’s go for the final drive.” He was also seen slapping himself repeatedly while speaking about his mother. At one point he said, “Next time I come, just give me love.” Soon after, Anurag reportedly accelerated the car to nearly 150 kmph and crashed it into a divider. The Instagram live ended immediately after the collision. Anurag Dobhal is widely known online as UK07 Rider and had also participated in Bigg Boss 17. He sustained injuries in the crash and has been admitted to Shubharti Hospital in Meerut, where he is currently undergoing treatment. See PHOTOS related to the incident... “Mom, give me love when I come next time” In the Instagram live video, Anurag emotionally said, “Mom, when I come in the next life, just give me love… I really needed love. There are no people left now, who should I call?” After saying this, he added, “Let’s go for the final drive.” In the video, he is seen playing an English song in the car and accelerating rapidly. Within moments, the speed touches around 144 kmph. During the drive, he suddenly turns the steering wheel, seemingly attempting to hit the divider. However, the live video abruptly stops at that moment. Second video surfaces, Anurag seen crying on the road Another video from the scene has also surfaced on social media. In the footage, Anurag’s car appears badly damaged, and he is seen lying on the road while people nearby rush to help him. Wearing a yellow T-shirt, Anurag is seen crying in pain as bystanders pull him out of the car and assist him. Had shared emotional 2-hour video four days ago Just four days before the incident, on March 4, Anurag had uploaded a nearly two-hour-long video on his YouTube channel. In the video, he opened up about his personal life struggles, including family disputes, marriage issues, leaving home, financial problems and mental stress. Throughout the video, he became emotional several times and even broke down while speaking. He said his life had changed drastically in recent years and that circumstances forced him to make his personal story public. Anurag also played audio recordings and conversations with family members in the video, stating that he had been dealing with mental stress for a long time.

stories.title: Ashutosh Maharaj attacked in moving train:Claims attacker tried to cut his nose; blames Shankaracharya’s disciple for assault
stories.summary: Ashutosh Maharaj, who had filed an FIR alleging sexual harassment of batuks against Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand, was reportedly attacked in a moving train on Sunday. According to Ashutosh Maharaj, he was travelling from Ghaziabad to Prayagraj on the Rewa Express and was seated in the First AC coach. He said that at around 5 am, when the train was near Sirathu railway station, he got up to go to the toilet. A man was standing near the door outside. Assault with sharp weapon Ashutosh Maharaj said that when he moved ahead, the attacker suddenly assaulted him from behind. The assailant allegedly tried to cut his nose with a sharp weapon and repeatedly struck his face and hands. He sustained serious injuries and lost a considerable amount of blood. According to Ashutosh Brahmachari, he somehow managed to escape and locked himself inside the train’s toilet to save his life. From there, he called the Government Railway Police (GRP) and reported the incident. FIR registered, investigation begins Ashutosh Maharaj has held Swami Avimukteshwaranand, his disciple Mukundanand and others responsible for the attack. Acting on the complaint, the GRP has registered an FIR and begun an investigation into the matter. Shankaracharya rejects allegations Responding to the accusations, Shankaracharya said the incident was merely a drama. According to him, Ashutosh was making such claims to create an atmosphere and obtain security protection. He said the allegations against him were intended only to attract media attention and divert focus from the ongoing journey. Ashutosh Maharaj hits back Shortly afterwards, Ashutosh Maharaj responded sharply to the Shankaracharya’s remarks. He said every drop of blood would be avenged through legal means. He claimed the attacker had said that his nose would be cut and offered at the feet of his 'guru'. Ashutosh said they would fight the matter through the law. Rejecting the counter-claims, he said it was absurd to suggest that someone would stage an attack on themselves and added that the Shankaracharya should try getting his own nose cut to understand..

stories.title: Two brothers killed YouTuber Salim Wastik over his controversial videos:3-min struggle leaves YouTuber with 14 wounds; attackers flee, later killed in police encounters
stories.summary: February 27, 2026, Friday. At 7:30 AM, Zeeshan and Gulfam reached the Loni area of Ghaziabad. They attacked ex-Muslim Salim Wastik (YouTuber). One had a paper cutter, the other had a knife. The entire attempt was to behead. The struggle continued for 3.5 minutes. Salim suffered 14 serious wounds on his neck, stomach, back, and chest. During this time, a woman arrived and raised an alarm. At this, both attackers fled. Pictures appeared in the Telegram group, stating that Salim, an Ex-Muslim, has been taken to the hospital. Both kept a fast the next day. Police identified both based on CCTV, vehicle numbers, and presence at the scene. When the search began, a confrontation occurred. Police killed Zeeshan in an encounter on March 1 and Gulfam on March 3. How was this incident planned? Who was behind the planning? Why did Zeeshan want rights to the Babri Masjid? Read Sunday Big Story... Salim left Islam and became an atheist 7 years ago Ghaziabad's Salim Vastik's original home is in Shamli district. 20 years ago, he left Shamli and settled in the Ashok Vihar area of Loni in Ghaziabad. Besides him, his family includes his wife and his son, Usman Khan. Salim previously worked in construction-related work. He also worked as a Maulvi for some time. Later, he became disillusioned with Islam. He left Islam and added 'Vastik' to his name. Salim bought land about one and a half kilometers away from his house in Ali Garden Colony, then built a house there. He opened his office in it and started working there. Salim had agreements with different TV channels, where he used to go for religious debates. He would debate there as an ex-Muslim. He would discuss matters related to Islam. Later, he created his YouTube channel and would comment about Islam on it. Misconduct in Jammu-Kashmir, Channel Deleted On April 22, 2025, a terrorist attack occurred in the Basran Valley of Pahalgam in Anantnag district of Jammu-Kashmir. 26 tourists were killed after being asked about their religion. This incident was condemned worldwide. Salim reached Jammu-Kashmir with his companions Aamir and Ahsan. They protested against this incident there. They spoke with some media personnel. They talked about boycotting Kashmir. Because of this, they became targets of local people. They were beaten up, and their social media accounts were forced to be deleted. Salim complained about this to the Jammu and Kashmir Police, but the police took no action. After this, Salim returned to Ghaziabad. He complained to the police here, but the police did not take action, saying it was a Kashmir matter. After this, Salim created another channel in his own name. Regarding the Pahalgam attack, Salim had said to a news channel - If we speak from our perspective, this was wrong. It is a terrorist attack, it is against humanity. But, if we look from Islam's perspective, they have done a virtuous deed. This is the work of Shabab. After the Kashmir incident, Salim became a target of extremists. On the other hand, Salim also started making more aggressive videos compared to before. At the beginning of the videos, he would often use offensive words. He would talk about Halala, Hadith, and Triple Talaq. While discussing these topics, he would quote verses from the Quran. Many people from the Muslim community would write abusive comments and give threats on these videos. They offered prayers before going to attack Salim Zeeshan (23) and Gulfam (42), who attacked Salim Wastik (50), were residents of Saidnagli town in Amroha. Their father, Buniyad Ali, works with wood. Both of them also did the same work. In Buniyad's family, besides these two sons, there are 5 daughters. Buniyad Ali has gotten all of them married. Gulfam was the eldest, and Zeeshan was the youngest. In 2013, Gulfam left Amroha and settled in the Khoda area of Ghaziabad. Here he lived in a rented room at the house of a person named Ali Hasan in Mangal Bazaar. After 2021, Zeeshan also went to Ghaziabad to join Gulfam. He worked in a company. Zeeshan studied at a local madrasa in Amroha. Then he passed 12th from a nearby inter-college. He grew a beard. He started actively participating in Islamic programs. He would make videos on social media, talking about Islam. In one video, he had talked about claiming rights to the Babri Masjid in Ayodhya. When Gulfam and Zeeshan would watch Salim's videos, they would become red with anger. Both brothers were also connected to some WhatsApp and Telegram groups. They would comment there. The other people there would talk about beheading. According to police sources, these two brothers had planned to kill Salim just 15 days ago. For this, they had chosen the holy month of Ramadan and Friday. On the morning of February 27, both were in their rented room. They had offered Fajr prayer (morning prayer) at 5:30 in the morning. Focus was on killing Salim by slitting his throat After this, Zeeshan and Gulfam took out their cousin's KTM bike. They reached Ali Garden Colony about 20 kilometers away. Both of them knew about both Salim's house and office. They knew when he came and went, at what time. At 7:54 in the morning, both reached Salim's office. At that time, Salim was lying on the sofa watching videos on his mobile. Both brothers went inside. Zeeshan first took out a paper cutter, and then Gulfam also took out a knife. Both brothers were focused entirely on Salim's throat. They both wanted to cut Salim's throat with full force. Salim was continuously screaming. During this, Gulfam says to Zeeshan, 'Kill him, don't be afraid.' After this, Zeeshan picked up a glass table lying there and broke it. Then he launched repeated attacks on Salim with his sharp pieces. The glass from the table got embedded in Salim's back. The CCTV footage that has emerged is 3 minutes and 39 seconds long. Zeeshan and Gulfam were still inside at that time. Sent attack photos to group, then went home After the attack, both took photos and videos of Salim suffering. They sent it to their people. The same picture also appeared on a Telegram channel called Muslim Army. This group has more than 18,300 members. It contained two photos. One was a smiling photo of Salim, with text below saying - Ex-Muslim Salim, treatment video coming soon... After the attack, another picture came where Salim was badly injured. Its caption read - Salim, an ex-Muslim, has been taken to the hospital. Want the full video? Many people in this comment group reacted to this. Zeeshan and Gulfam left Salim's office after carrying out the incident. In this attack, Zeeshan's finger was also slightly cut. This caused blood to get on the clothes. Both went back towards their room. However, on the way, a person recorded a video of these two, considering them suspicious. This video came to light later. After reaching the room, both brothers changed their clothes. Then they reached their home in Saidnagali in Amroha by bike. Here, the elder brother, Gulfam, stayed for some time. Then he went back to Ghaziabad by bike. While, Zeeshan stayed in the village. He fasted the whole day and had iftar with the family in the evening. He took leave every Friday, so the family did not suspect Zeeshan was religiously orthodox. That's why he took leave on Friday instead of Sunday. He came home every week. Therefore, family members did not suspect that he had come after attacking someone. The next day, Zeeshan kept another fast. After the morning prayer, he caught a bus to Ghaziabad. In the afternoon, he talked to his mother on the phone and spoke about offering prayers. On the other hand, after this high-profile incident, 10 police teams were formed. 70 personnel were engaged in searching for Salim's attackers. Crime Branch and STF also became active. A total of 210 CCTVs were examined. The mobile network was investigated at the scene. By February 28, police had discovered that this incident was carried out by Zeeshan and Gulfam. On the night of March 1, both were seen coming in the Loni area itself. When Station In-charge Nitin Chaudhary tried to stop them, firing broke out. About 25 to 30 rounds were fired in 15 minutes. Zeeshan was hit by one bullet in the chest and one in the leg. However, Gulfam escaped. Police took Zeeshan to the hospital, where doctors declared him dead. On March 3, police surrounded Gulfam in the Indirapuram police station area. He also opened fire. However, he was killed in retaliatory police firing. This means both brothers were killed in police encounters within 48 hours. Gulfam was hot-tempered, Zeeshan was calm but cunning Upon talking to people living near their homes in Amroha, it was revealed that Gulfam had an angry temperament. Whereas Zeeshan remained calm. He actively participated in Islamic religious events. He would collect donations in the neighborhood. He made Islamic videos on social media. There are also discussions that both of them used to attend the Jamaat. They would meet Muslims coming from different countries across the world. The way Salim was attacked, 2 similar murders have taken place in the last few years. First- Umesh Kolhe was murdered in Amravati, Maharashtra. On June 21, 2022, 54-year-old Umesh had posted in a WhatsApp group supporting BJP spokesperson Nupur Sharma's comments on Prophet Muhammad. This became the main reason. Yusuf, associated with Tabligi Jamaat, killed Umesh Kolhe by slitting his throat in the middle of the road. Umesh had known Yusuf for 16 years. Umesh had also helped in Yusuf's wedding. Police had arrested 10 more people in this case. Second- Just 7 days after the murder of Umesh Kolhe, Kanhaiya Lal Teli was murdered in the Udaipur district of Rajasthan. Gaus Mohammad and Mohammad Riyaz came on a bike and started making a video. After this, both of them slit Kanhaiya's throat and killed him. Kanhaiya had posted a comment by Nupur Sharma on his Facebook. This became the reason for his murder, too. Both main accused are in jail. NIA is handling this case. Court had objected to 'Sar Tan Se Juda' This slogan of 'Sar Tan Se Juda' has been going on in the country for a long time. However, after the Nupur Sharma case came up in 2022, it started being chanted continuously. There was violence in Bareilly, and slogans were raised. This slogan was also raised there. The situation became such that the Allahabad High Court had to object to this slogan. The single bench of Judge Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal had rejected the bail application of Rehan, who was arrested during the violent protest in Bareilly. The judge said - Such violent slogans raised in the name of Islam are completely contrary to Prophet Muhammad's ideals. If a follower of Islam raises slogans about beheading someone for insulting the Prophet, it is an insult to the Prophet Muhammad's ideals. This slogan is not connected to India's cultural, legal, and religious traditions. It is influenced by blasphemy laws and violent incidents in the neighboring country. The judge had said - Religious slogans like Jai Shri Ram and Nara-e-Takbir are not a crime if they are not being used to intimidate someone or incite violence. However, if they are being used to incite violence, then it is wrong. Maulana said - What happened was wrong, religious comments should not have been made Darul Uloom's Firangi Mahal spokesperson, Maulana Sufyan Nizami, says - Whatever happened was wrong. However, the law does not give anyone the right to speak inappropriately about anyone's religion. What Salim was saying fills people with anger. Educated people respond like educated people, but those who are uneducated, or let's say those who are instigated, become violent. Sufyan says that we need to ensure that the administration takes timely action against those who speak inappropriately about any religion. However, even after the encounter of Zeeshan and Gulfam, the police investigation has not ended yet. Efforts are being made to get to the bottom of this case. Their Pakistan connections are being investigated. Attempts are being made to contact people present in that Telegram group.

stories.title: Brick kiln worker’s son becomes IAS:Vimal Kumar from Raebareli secures 107th rank in UPSC; celebrates with 7-km procession
stories.summary: Ramdev’s son Vimal Kumar, who worked at a brick kiln in Raebareli, has become an IAS officer, securing 107th rank in UPSC. To celebrate his success, Vimal led a 7-kilometre procession with a convoy. His convoy included 12 cars, a DJ system and more than 50 bikes. People welcomed Vimal at several places and garlanded him with flowers. Father Ramdev’s eyes welled up with tears at his son’s achievement. Speaking about his success, Vimal Kumar said, “A DM madam once visited Navodaya Vidyalaya. That’s when I decided to become an IAS officer.” To keep expenses low, he took online classes three times while staying in the village. Read Vimal Kumar’s journey to becoming an IAS officer. First see 3 pictures... Ramdev lives in Chandemau village of Khiro block in Raebareli district. He has 3 sons and 2 daughters. Vimal Kumar (30) is the youngest son. On his son becoming an IAS, Ramdev says - Very happy. I educated my son by working as a laborer at brick kilns and doing sharecropping. Dainik Bhaskar team reached Chandemau village, 32 kilometers away from district headquarters. At that time, Vimal Kumar was seated in a car. Family members and villagers were showering flowers on him. DJ was playing in the background. As Vimal's convoy moved forward, more cars and bikes joined the procession. Gradually, more than 12 cars and over 50 bikes joined the convoy. People kept stopping Vimal to shower flowers and garland him. The 7-kilometer procession lasted for about 2 hours. After this, the village locals brought Vimal Kumar home. The number of well-wishers at home was continuously increasing. We spoke with Vimal's elder brother Ajit Kumar. Ajit says - the family's financial condition is very modest. I myself work as a laborer in Raebareli. Despite financial constraints, we never let any obstacles come in the way of Vimal's education. We continuously encouraged him. Vimal's sister-in-law says - this success has come after many struggles. There were many difficulties and obstacles at home, but Vimal did not give up his goal. He had come during Holi. When the result came yesterday, he said "Bhabhi, my result is out. I have been selected." Buffaloes tied at the door, house was recently plastered Vimal's house is half permanent and half temporary. There are 5 rooms, out of which only 2 are permanent. Vimal's elder brother has gone abroad to earn, which has improved the financial condition of the house. After this, the front part of the house has been plastered. Two buffaloes are tied outside their house. Besides this, there is a fodder cutting machine and hay stored. From village primary school to IIT Family members say, “Vimal Kumar completed his early education from the village primary school Chandemau. After this, he was selected in Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Maharajganj. He studied there till 10th class. For further studies, he went to Kerala and then reached Delhi for higher education.” In 2020, Vimal Kumar obtained his B.Tech degree from IIT Delhi. After this, he started preparing for UPSC examination. He did not take help from any big coaching institute for this. He mostly prepared through self-study while staying in Raebareli. Vimal explains - Appeared for UPSC exam continuously from 2021 to 2025. Continued preparation without coaching even during the Corona pandemic. In the first 4 attempts, reached the interview stage but couldn't get final selection. Even after this, I didn't give up. Prepared while staying in Lucknow and cleared the interview in the 5th attempt. This time I got 107th rank. Did online preparation, faced failure for 4 years Vimal Kumar says - Online preparation reduced expenses. I faced failure continuously for 4 years. Last year (in 2024) I gave the interview, where I missed selection by 12 marks. Felt very discouraged after failing. Despite this, I didn't give up. Tried once again and passed. Vimal Kumar says - Regular study, discipline and proper use of time is the real key to success. If you have a clear goal and continue working hard despite difficult circumstances, success will surely come.

stories.title: Anticipatory bail of 8 accused in multi-crore fraud case rejected:Fraud committed by giving fake s for providing gas and petrol agency
stories.summary: 8 accused who committed fraud of more than ₹21 crores by giving fake and false s in the name of providing kerosene, petrol and gas agencies had their anticipatory bail applications rejected by ADJ Sapna Tripathi's court. A report was filed against the accused at the Kotwali. DM had ordered investigation on July 31, 2007 False s were given for providing petrol pumps, kerosene and gas agencies from Hindustan and Bharat Petroleum. Fraud of more than ₹21 crore rupees was committed across the country in the name of providing agencies. On July 31, 2007, the then District Magistrate had ordered an investigation in this case. Based on the investigation report, the then Sub Divisional Magistrate had recommended filing a case in December 2008. Case was filed against these people A case was registered at Kotwali police station in 2010 based on the complaint of KK Kamani, a resident of Pandu Nagar. ADGC Pradeep Kumar Sahu said that during investigation, names of Girish Chandra from village Rajupur Amrauli Kannauj, Atul Kumar Katiyar from village Kachhiyapur Kusumkhor Bangar Kannauj, Arvind Kumar from village Kusumkhor Kannauj, Mukesh Chandra Katiyar from village Rajpur Kirtpur Kannauj, Sunil Kumar Katiyar from Bank Colony Devin Purwa Sarai Meera, Rakesh Kumar Katiyar originally from village Baranda Bilhaur now residing in Indra Nagar Kalyanpur Kanpur, Arjun Singh from Bima Vihar Lakhanpur and Umesh Chandra from village Khadamau Araul came to light. The court has rejected the anticipatory bail petitions of all the accused.

stories.title: Bihar's Maulana made inflammatory remarks about Yogi's mother:People take to streets in Lucknow, burn effigy and take out funeral procession
stories.summary: Bihar's Maulana Abdullah Salim Chaturvedi made objectionable and inflammatory statements about UP CM Yogi Adityanath's mother. This has angered BJP workers and Yogi fans. On Saturday, people burned an effigy of the Maulana in Lucknow. They trampled it under their feet. Earlier, the youth carried out a mock funeral procession of the Maulana in Hazratganj. After that, they poured petrol and set fire at the intersection. Police tried to stop the students but failed. People created a huge ruckus. Angry people raised loud slogans against the Maulana. They demanded that a case be filed and that he be arrested. The protesting youth said - Yogi is the heart and soul of UP. His mother is the mother of all India. Mothers and sisters will also protest for him. Meanwhile, BJP leader and UP Women's Commission Vice President Aparna Bisht Yadav targeted the Maulana. She said, The status of mother is very high in any religion. In Islam too, mother has been given a very high status, but this Maulana has not read such texts. Stop making such vulgar comments, he should apologize. Protests will continue until Maulana apologizes Abhishek, a protesting student from Lucknow University, said that Maulana has insulted our Chief Minister's mother. If the person who made the statement does not apologize, we will come in larger numbers tomorrow and protest. Such people make these kinds of statements to boost their political career. One can oppose Yogi Adityanath's policies, oppose his ideas, but commenting on his mother is extremely wrong. Tomorrow, mothers and sisters from our homes will come out and join the protest. 'Will make Maulana's condition like an effigy' Protesting Jatin Shukla said, we have burned the effigy of Maulana Salim from Bihar. He has shown his mentality during the sacred months of Holi and Ramzan. Yogi is the Chief Minister of such a large state. He is a saint. Objectionable comments were made about his mother. This will not be tolerated. Today we burned his effigy. Now we will file a case against the Maulana and work to send him to jail. Just as the effigy is burning, people with a mentality like Maulana will also burn. During his speech, Maulana made objectionable comments about CM Adityanath's mother. He made false statements about the cow slaughter law and the police in Uttar Pradesh. There is anger across the entire state because of this. 'Yogi's mother is the mother of entire India' Jatin said, it's a matter of investigation whether such people are getting protection from someone. Just a few days ago, in Lucknow University's Lal Baradari case, Congress and SP people were talking about unity and brotherhood. Today, all those people are silent on this issue. This shows their political dignity. Making such comments about someone's mother is extremely wrong. Yogi is a saint who left his home and family. Yogi's mother is the mother of the entire nation of India. This comment is not on Yogi's mother, but on Mother India. Ayodhya Hanumangarhi Mahant says - Maulana should be hanged Saints and Mahants of Ayodhya are angry over Maulana's comments. Hanumangarhi's Mahant Raju Das said that the Maulana who spoke against Gorakhpeeth's head priest, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath's mother, should be publicly hanged. Meanwhile, Saket Bhawan's Mahant Sitaram Das said that Maulana should be shot in the chest, not in the leg. Maulana had said - Yogiji's... Maulana Abdullah Salim's video has surfaced on social media. It is being reported that he gave this speech at a religious gathering in Bihar during the month of Ramadan. The Maulana said, 'About Yogiji... would also come and eat. You would eat mutton. You would eat meat. It's a controversial topic, I won't go there. Do you know what kind of law has been made in Uttar Pradesh? Ask Mr. Dil (pointing to a person sitting on the stage). If someone has Yogiji's... my Hindu brothers, please don't mind. I respect your Mataji. We respect your beliefs. But, we also invite you to believe that there is no better belief than Islam. If up to 250 grams of Yogiji's... is found, there is an order to shoot holes below their knees.' (We cannot write the Maulana's complete statement here. Therefore, the objectionable words have been marked with dots.) Why Maulana writes 'Chaturvedi'... Many Muslims use the surname 'Chaturvedi'. This is due to the knowledge and study of all four Vedas (Rigveda, Yajurveda, Samaveda, Atharvaveda). It is a title.

stories.title: 600 skin disease cases reported in Kanpur within 48 hours:Chemical colours linked to infections; women and children worst affected
stories.summary: After the Holi festivities, long queues of women are now seen at hospital OPDs. In the last 48 hours, around 500 to 600 new cases of skin diseases have emerged, which has increased the health department's concerns. The most shocking thing is that more than half of these patients are women and young girls who have been using 'Betnovate' or other steroid-containing creams for a long time without medical advice. This deadly combination of color and steroids has not only caused swelling on faces but has also left deep wounds. Dermatologist Dr. Swetank said that most women coming to the OPD have one thing in common - they were directly purchasing and applying steroid creams from medical stores. Some were using these creams to remove acne, while others were using them to clear dark spots and blemishes on their faces. They said - Continuous use of steroids makes the upper layer of skin extremely thin and delicate. When chemical colors were applied to such sensitive skin and sunlight fell on it, the reaction increased manifold. This is why these women are experiencing much more burning and pain compared to normal patients. Dr. Shwetank said that women whose skin was already damaged due to steroids are showing severe swelling on their faces and lips after Holi. In many cases, watery discharge has also started from wounds on the cheeks and forehead. As soon as these women step into sunlight, their faces turn red, and they experience unbearable itching and burning. Besides women, young children and people with dry skin have also been affected by this problem, because their skin is naturally soft and delicate, on which chemical colors caused immediate allergic reactions.

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav says, ‘I wanted Mayawati as PM’:Takes jibe at Nitish's Rajya Sabha nomination, says, 'BJP didn't let him retire as CM'
stories.summary: When we had an alliance with BSP, we wanted to make Mayawati the Prime Minister. When the 'India' alliance was formed, we wanted to make Nitish Kumar the Prime Minister, but BJP didn't even give him a chance to retire as CM. Now he will retire from Rajya Sabha. SP chief Akhilesh Yadav said these things during a press conference in Lucknow on Saturday. He took a jibe at CM Yogi's Singapore and Japan visit. These remarks were made by Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav during a press conference in Lucknow on Saturday. He took a dig at Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath over his visit to Singapore and Japan. Akhilesh said that whenever a programme is organized, people usually plan trips after the farewell. “But this is the first Chief Minister who went abroad even before the farewell,” he remarked. On Deputy CM Keshav Prasad Maurya's helicopter emergency landing, he said - They must not have given him a new helicopter. The machine should always be good. We wish for his good health. We all travel by helicopter. It should be in good condition. Our demand is that he should be given a new helicopter. Key points from Akhilesh's press conference- ‘Prices will fall only when BJP leaves power’ Akhilesh Yadav said vehicles carry more than 50% tax, which is why people are forced to buy expensive cars. He added that inflation will come down only when the BJP is voted out of power. ‘One halwai, one sweet’ jibe at BJP Referring to the slogan ‘One Nation, One Election’, Akhilesh mocked the BJP, saying the party distributed gujiyas on Holi under a new formula, ‘one halwai, one sweet’. He warned people to remain cautious. Why weren’t smugglers’ call records checked? Citing the Kanpur drug case, Akhilesh said police call records revealed links with smugglers involved in the trade of cannabis and opium. He questioned why the call details of the smugglers themselves were not examined. SP to file FIR over BJP’s song Akhilesh said the Samajwadi Party would file an FIR against a song allegedly launched by the BJP targeting the party. He added that it would expose the alleged nexus once the complaint is filed. Taunts at CM Yogi over Japan visit Taking a swipe at Yogi Adityanath, Akhilesh said the chief minister did not even visit Kyoto during his Japan tour and mocked his enthusiasm during a high-speed train ride. Claims BJP did not build new thermal plants He said most thermal power plants in Uttar Pradesh were set up during the Samajwadi Party government and challenged the BJP to name even one built in the last decade. Concern over Indians stranded in Gulf countries Akhilesh said the government should bring back Indians stuck in Gulf nations. He also criticised India’s foreign policy, claiming external factors appear to be influencing decisions. Calls Election Commission ‘dishonest’ over voter list issue He accused the Election Commission of irregularities in voter list revisions, alleging fake signatures and attempts to delete votes in places like Sarojini Nagar and Bidhuna. ‘Shankaracharya is an institution of Sanatan’ Akhilesh said allegations made against Shankaracharya were attempts to defame Sanatan traditions, stressing that Shankaracharya represents an important spiritual institution. ‘Government celebrated Holi while a poor man died waiting’ He claimed a person died while waiting during a public grievance hearing and blamed the administration for negligence during the Holi festival. Meetings meant to decide BJP tickets Akhilesh alleged that the BJP’s ongoing meetings near Delhi and in Kanpur are aimed at deciding which sitting MLAs may lose their election tickets.

stories.title: Engineer blames sister for ending his relationship with girlfriend:Victim stabbed 40 times in Moradabad; blood from room to kitchen
stories.summary: Engineer brother Hardik (25), who killed his engineer sister by stabbing her with a knife, is still out of police custody in Moradabad. Hardik stabbed his sister Himshikha 40 times with a knife. Blood was scattered everywhere from the room to the kitchen in the house. He also attacked his mother with a knife, who is currently hospitalized in an injured condition. The exact reason for the murder will only be known after the accused Hardik is caught, but so far, it has been learned that Hardik was having an affair with a girl from Pune. Some time ago, he had broken up with his girlfriend. Hardik's mother, Neelima, who is admitted to the hospital, told police during questioning, "Hardik had become angry since the breakup with his girlfriend. He was adamant about marrying his girlfriend. While she had already left him. Hardik somehow felt that his breakup happened because of his sister Himshikha and me. That's why he had become irritable. He would get angry over small things." Hardik and his sister Himshikha were twins. Actually, Hardik killed his sister in broad daylight on Friday. After the incident, he brought his mother home from the office where she had gone for work. When the mother went inside, she started screaming after seeing her daughter's blood-soaked body. Seeing this, Hardik also attacked his mother with a knife. Two neighboring women arrived after hearing the screams. After this, Hardik fled in a car. When the women went inside the house, the mother and daughter were lying on the ground covered in blood. Police were informed. The incident took place in the Majhola police station area of Moradabad. After separation from husband, Neelima started living in Moradabad Himshikha and Hardik were twin siblings. Like her brother, the sister was also an engineer. Both worked in an IT company in Gurgaon. About a year ago, Hardik lost his job. After this, he started living with his sister in Gurgaon and began uploading content on YouTube. The siblings lived in Gurgaon, and their mother, Neelima, worked in an insurance company in Moradabad. She lives in a rented house in Buddhi Vihar. Police say the family originally hails from Badaun. After separating from her husband about 9 years ago, Neelima started living in Moradabad with both children and started a job here. After completing their education, the children started working in Gurgaon. As a result, Neelima lived alone in Moradabad. The children would come to meet their mother in Moradabad during festivals. On March 2nd itself, the brother and sister arrived together by car from Gurgaon to Moradabad to meet their mother and celebrate Holi. Chased and stabbed sister inside house Hardik had so much hatred for his sister that he killed her with extreme brutality. He chased Himshikha around the house and stabbed her with a knife. She has knife wounds on almost every part of her body, including stomach, chest, and neck. The total number of wounds will only be known after the post-mortem. However, police officers said that every part of the body was stabbed with a knife. Himshikha's dead body has not been autopsied until Saturday afternoon. Because, her brother has been absconding since the murder. While the mother is hospitalized due to injuries. Police will also take family consent before the post-mortem. Therefore, her family has been called from Badaun. Police will conduct Himshikha's post-mortem only after getting consent from the family. Blood everywhere from kitchen to room in the house Blood was found scattered at the crime scene in both rooms, the courtyard, and the kitchen. Police suspect that Himshikha was possibly working in the kitchen when her brother Hardik attacked her with a knife. She ran into both rooms of the house to escape her brother's attack, but could not survive. The blood scattered in both rooms and the courtyard testifies that Himshikha tried her best to save her life. 10 police teams engaged in search for Hardik After killing his sister, Hardik fled from home in a car. SSP Satpal Antil of Moradabad has formed 10 teams to search for him. SP City Ranvijay Singh is leading these teams. Police teams are also checking CCTV footage at toll booths on highways. Additionally, electronic surveillance is being used to arrest Hardik. Real motive will only be known after Hardik's arrest SSP Satpal Antil says that why Hardik attacked his sister and mother with a knife will only be known after Hardik's arrest. Police teams are searching for him, and he will be arrested soon.

stories.title: Google Maps led attackers to ex-Muslim YouTuber’s office:Police scan CCTVs of 140 km route to trace Zeeshan and Gulfam
stories.summary: A new revelation has emerged in the attack on Ghaziabad-based YouTuber Saleem Wastik, who had left Islam. The investigation found that the attackers, real brothers Zeeshan and Gulfam, reached Saleem’s office using Google Maps and kept watch on his activities after confirming the location. Saleem (50) often shared his office address and mobile number in videos on his YouTube channel. Using this information, the accused traced his location. Zeeshan used Google Maps to find the route, and both reached his office. They conducted reconnaissance for one or two days and monitored Saleem’s movements. Later, finding an opportunity, they carried out the attack and fled. After the incident, police formed five teams to arrest the accused and scanned CCTV footage from roads covering nearly 140 km, which eventually helped identify them. CCTV reveals brutal attack Ex-Muslim YouTuber Saleem Wastik was attacked on February 27 and suffered 14 stab wounds. He is currently admitted to a private hospital in Delhi. Two surgeries have been performed, but his condition remains critical. Police have killed both assailant brothers, Zeeshan and Gulfam, in an encounter, while the search for the mastermind continues. After the encounter, some people questioned the police action. On Wednesday, CCTV footage of the attack surfaced, showing the brutality of the two brothers. In the video, one of them can be heard saying, “Hit him, don’t be afraid.” After the incident, Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath took cognisance of the matter and said the culprits would not be spared. Where the accused went after the deadly attack? CCTV footage scanned across 140 km On February 27 at 7:54 AM, Zeeshan and his elder brother, Gulfam, broke into Saleem Wastik’s house and attacked him. After the incident, police got key clues from CCTV cameras installed at Saleem’s office. Investigation revealed the bike-borne attackers entered Delhi through the Wazirabad border. From there, they were traced to Mangal Bazar in Khoda near the Ghaziabad–Delhi border through street CCTV. They reached their room, changed clothes, stayed for about six minutes, and left again with a bag. The two then crossed the Hapur border via Ghaziabad on the Delhi–Moradabad–Lucknow Highway and reached Brijghat. After Brijghat, CCTV cameras captured them in Gajraula on Sambhal Road in Amroha. They also stopped for 5–10 minutes in Hasanpur before reaching their hometown, Said Nagli via Sambhal Road. A few hours later, Zeeshan fled, while Gulfam left the house on February 28. Police, along with Ghaziabad SWAT and Crime Branch teams, scanned CCTV footage from toll plazas and over 150 locations within a 140-km radius. This helped confirm that the attackers were residents of Amroha district. Stopped for 2 minutes before Saleem’s house Mobiles to be sent for forensic examination Police recovered a Samsung mobile phone from Gulfam, a one-lakh bounty criminal killed in an encounter. They also seized a pistol, cartridges, a KTM bike stolen from Delhi, an Aadhaar card, an Ayushman card, and a driving license. A backpack containing a kurta-pajama, a round cap, and a jacket was also found. Gulfam’s mobile phone will be sent for forensic analysis, and Zeeshan’s phone will also be examined by the Forensic Science Laboratory (FSL). Linked to radical social media pages According to police, several Instagram pages are operating under the name ‘Muslim Army’ and allegedly spreading radical content. Initial investigation suggests Zeeshan was also associated with this group. CCTV footage of the attack CCTV footage shows the shocking sequence Saleem Wastik in critical condition Saleem Wastik is currently admitted to Max Hospital in Saket, Delhi. He is in the ICU. He is currently unable to speak or eat and drink. Doctors have performed surgery on the knife wounds on his throat. However, his condition is still critical due to liver damage from the knife wound in his stomach. Saleem's wife has been shifted to another location for security reasons. It is feared that her life is also in danger. Saleem's only son, Usman, is at the hospital with relatives. However, the son says that he is not being allowed to meet his father. Son Usman says, Our financial situation is bad at the moment. One lakh rupees were given by Meerut leader Amit Jani for treatment. Around 3 to 4 lakh rupees have been spent so far, and a lot of money has also been borrowed. Latest update on Ghaziabad police probe Case being investigated from 3 angles First- Is there another real mastermind behind the attack on Saleem Wastik? Second- Are other YouTubers who speak against Islam, like Saleem Wastik, also targeted by these people? Third- Which organization were Zeeshan and Gulfam working for? In contact with a Maulana from Delhi Zeeshan and Gulfam were in contact with a Maulana from Delhi. Police believe that both were receiving guidance from the Maulana. Zeeshan's Instagram account shows him giving Islamic speeches like a Maulana. It has also come to light that both went to Delhi before the attack on Saleem Wastik. Ghaziabad Crime Branch may soon interrogate the Maulana.

stories.title: Dy CM Keshav Maurya’s helicopter makes emergency landing:Chopper develops technical issues mid-air at 2,000 feet; landed in Lucknow
stories.summary: An emergency landing was carried out for the helicopter of Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Prasad Maurya in Lucknow. According to information, smoke suddenly started coming out of the helicopter while it was in the air. As a precaution, the helicopter was diverted and landed at Amausi Airport. Maurya was leaving for a two-day visit to Kaushambi. He was scheduled to inaugurate the two-day Saras Mahotsav programme at the Babu Singh Degree College ground in Sayara. His helicopter had taken off from La Martiniere Ground on Saturday morning. During the flight, due to a technical fault, the display first stopped working and then smoke began to rise. Within moments, smoke filled the cabin. The pilot immediately contacted Lucknow ATC and sought permission for an emergency landing at Amausi Airport. The helicopter was landed there amid tight security arrangements. As soon as it landed, security and technical teams immediately surrounded it. The Deputy Chief Minister was safely taken out of the helicopter. He will now travel to Kaushambi in another helicopter. The aerial distance between La Martiniere College (La Marts) and Amausi Airport (Chaudhary Charan Singh International Airport) is about 11–12 kilometres.

stories.title: Rajya Sabha nominations may favour leaders with Assembly-winning clout:BJP set for 7 seats in UP, SP bets on third
stories.summary: Rajya Sabha elections are currently a topic of discussion across the country. Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar and BJP National President Nitin Naveen have filed their nominations for the Upper House. Meanwhile, in Uttar Pradesh, Rajya Sabha elections are scheduled to be held at the end of the year, but political speculation has already begun. Questions are being raised over whether the BJP will again field its current members and veteran leaders such as Union Minister Hardeep Singh Puri, Brijlal, Dr. Dinesh Sharma, Geeta Shakya, and Neeraj Shekhar, or opt for new faces. Attention is also on how many seats will be contested in UP, the electoral math behind them, and which leaders have a strong claim and why. Rajya Sabha elections due in UP Uttar Pradesh has a total quota of 31 Rajya Sabha seats, of which the term of 10 members will end on November 25 this year. The election process is expected to begin in October or November. With the polls scheduled just before the Assembly elections, the BJP is likely to decide its candidates while maintaining social and regional balance. Experts believe some current members may get another term, while new faces could replace others. After the elections, the Samajwadi Party’s strength in the Upper House will increase by one seat, while the BSP will have no representation. Rajya Sabha math in UP BJP’s 7, SP’s 2 seats almost certain The NDA has 290 MLAs in the UP Assembly: BJP 257, Apna Dal (S) 13, Rashtriya Lok Dal 9, Suheldev Bharatiya Samaj Party 6, and Nishad Party 5. The Samajwadi Party has 102 MLAs, Jansatta Dal Loktantrik 2, and BSP 1, while three seats are vacant and will be filled in elections. Around 36–40 MLA votes are required to win one Rajya Sabha seat. In such a scenario, BJP is certain to win seven seats and SP two out of the 10 seats. SP will have to struggle for the third seat, while BJP may try for an eighth. BSP may lose Upper House presence After the Lok Sabha, BSP’s presence in the Rajya Sabha is also set to end. For the first time since its formation, the party may have no members in either House of Parliament. The term of BSP’s lone Rajya Sabha MP Ramji ends on November 25, 2026. In the Assembly, BSP has only one MLA, Umashankar Singh, while at least 10 proposers and seconders are required to file a Rajya Sabha nomination, making BSP ineligible to file a nomination on its own. Support deal with BJP or SP possible Political analysts say BSP candidates could file nominations with the support of either BJP or SP. BJP may also adopt a strategy of arranging support through allied parties and unattached MLAs, avoiding direct backing so BSP is not seen as BJP’s B-team. Whose claim is strong, and why? Brijlal might be repeated The term of BJP's Rajya Sabha MP and former UP DGP Brijlal will end on November 25. Brijlal is BJP's Dalit face. On issues related to Dalits and law and order, Brijlal aggressively puts forward BJP's stand by attacking SP and BSP. Experts believe that the party might give him another chance to go to Rajya Sabha. If he is not given a chance to go to Rajya Sabha, then he might be made to contest the assembly elections from a seat reserved for SC in UP. Dr. Dinesh Sharma seen as strong Brahmin face Former Deputy CM Dr. Dinesh Sharma was sent to the Rajya Sabha after the demise of MP Hardwar Dubey. Amid discussions over Brahmin displeasure in UP, Sharma recently faced criticism from the community over the UGC issue at a meeting. Experts say he remains BJP’s key Brahmin face and is active across the state, including Lucknow, so the party may give him another Rajya Sabha term. Uncertainty over Hardeep Singh Puri Union Minister Hardeep Singh Puri is currently serving his second Rajya Sabha term from UP and handles key ministries such as Urban Development and Petroleum. His name recently surfaced in the Epstein Files and earlier in another controversy. Experts believe that if he is dropped in the proposed Modi cabinet expansion, he may not return to the Rajya Sabha; however, if he remains a minister, he could get a third term from UP in November. Neeraj Shekhar may get another term Neeraj Shekhar, son of former PM Chandrashekhar, joined BJP from SP during the Article 370 abrogation to help the party secure a Rajya Sabha majority. BJP later sent him to the Rajya Sabha again in 2020, and he may receive another opportunity. BL Verma’s nomination almost certain Union Minister of State for Cooperation BL Verma is serving his second Rajya Sabha term. A prominent Lodhi leader from UP and considered close to PM Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah, he was also a contender for UP BJP state president. As a Union minister, his Rajya Sabha nomination is considered almost certain. Arun Singh’s chances depend on party role BJP National General Secretary Arun Singh’s future depends on his role in the new team to be formed by BJP National President Nitin Nabin. If he does not get a position such as General Secretary or Vice President, he may be sent to the Rajya Sabha again. Geeta Shakya may be replaced Geeta Shakya, currently Mahila Morcha state president, was sent to the Rajya Sabha while heading the women’s wing, fulfilling both the women’s and Shakya community representation. Experts say a new Mahila Morcha president may be appointed before the elections, so another woman leader could be nominated instead of her. Seema Dwivedi may not return Seema Dwivedi from Jaunpur, who was sent to the Rajya Sabha in 2020 and has also served as MLA from Gadwara, may be replaced as BJP could give another woman leader an opportunity under the current political equation. Position of the opposition and BSP Ramgopal Yadav certain to return to Rajya Sabha Ramgopal Yadav, SP’s senior national general secretary and a close confidant of party chief Akhilesh Yadav, is considered certain to enter the Rajya Sabha again. He also acts as a key link between the central government and the Samajwadi Party. Ramji Gautam’s future depends on Mayawati Ramji Gautam is currently BSP’s only Rajya Sabha member, but the party lacks enough MLAs to file a nomination in the upcoming elections. His political future now depends on BSP supremo Mayawati. If Mayawati secures support from BJP and NDA allies, BSP could become eligible to file a nomination. In that case, it will be seen whether Mayawati again backs Ramji Gautam or introduces a new face. Perspective of political experts Contest between BJP and SP Senior journalist Anand Rai believes the Rajya Sabha elections will see a direct contest between the BJP and SP, with both parties selecting candidates while keeping the upcoming Assembly elections and political circumstances in mind. As for the BSP, it does not even have enough numbers to file a nomination. Senior journalist Akhilesh Bajpai says the BSP is going through the worst phase in its political history. For the first time, the party will not have enough strength to even file a nomination in the Rajya Sabha elections. Currently, BSP has no members in the Legislative Council or the Lok Sabha, and after November 25 it will also have no representation in the Rajya Sabha. Meanwhile, the BJP is expected to focus on winning eight seats.

stories.title: Kanpur cop amasses ₹100 crore from hashish, marijuana trade:Tipped off smugglers with emojis before raids, audio clips leaked
stories.summary: An internal investigation has revealed shocking allegations against several policemen in Kanpur. According to findings from the probe ordered by Police Commissioner Raghuvir Lal, some police personnel were allegedly helping hashish and marijuana smugglers instead of acting against them. Suspicion arose when smugglers began vacating their dens just before police raids. The commissioner then ordered a check of the call detail records (CDR) of certain policemen. The CDRs of one sub-inspector and three head constables showed frequent contact with suspected smugglers. When their mobile phones were examined, investigators found audio recordings in which policemen were allegedly giving tips to smugglers about moving drugs such as marijuana and hashish to avoid raids. A departmental inquiry has been initiated and four policemen have been suspended. Property Worth ₹100 Crore Found in Head Constable’s Name During the investigation, the Police Commissioner also ordered scrutiny of the properties owned by the accused policemen. The probe found that Head Constable Jitendra Pratap Singh, posted at Sachendi police station, had allegedly acquired property worth around ₹100 crore. He purchased a 600-yard plot near Ashoka Hotel in Mandhana and also built a 200-yard house there. Investigators also found several benami properties in the names of his wife and relatives, along with gold worth crores. Emoji Messages Used to Alert Smugglers Investigators also discovered that some policemen allegedly used emoji messages on mobile phones to warn smugglers about surveillance or possible raids. These coded messages were reportedly sent to help traffickers move their goods before police action. A departmental inquiry is currently ongoing against the suspended officers. Kamlakant’s Support to Smugglers in Three Areas Head Constable Kamlakant, currently posted in the police line for the past one and a half years, was found to have allegedly run drug operations in Kanjarnapurwa, Naubasta and Kidwai Nagar using his influence. Investigators revealed that Golu Pahadi, who was caught with 53 kg of cannabis in Kidwai Nagar, had been operating his business under Kamlakant’s protection. Inspector’s Support to Babita, Who Sold Marijuana Near Temple Another case involved Babita, who was allegedly selling marijuana while pretending to sell flowers near Panki Temple. She reportedly had the support of Inspector Shravan Kumar Tiwari. Due to complaints against the inspector, DCP West SM Kasim Abidi had earlier submitted a detailed investigation report to the Joint Police Commissioner. Head Constable Supplying Drugs in Sarvodayanagar Meanwhile, Head Constable Ranjit Sharma, who was suspended from Kakadev police station, was allegedly supplying marijuana and hashish in Sarvodayanagar. He was also accused of providing shelter to traffickers operating in Sarvodayanagar and Kakadev Coaching Mandi. Jitendra Pratap Singh’s Posting History Raises Questions Head Constable Jitendra Pratap Singh had been posted at Sachendi police station for about one and a half months, where he drove the station in-charge’s jeep. Complaints surfaced that he was settling disputes over valuable land deals in exchange for money, after which he was removed from the police station. He was later posted to the Crime Branch, but was again removed after allegations of links with bookies and smugglers surfaced. How the Police–Smuggler Nexus Came to Light The investigation began on October 7, 2025, when Police Commissioner Raghuvir Lal took charge in Kanpur. While reviewing old records, he noticed a rise in marijuana and hashish smuggling in certain parts of the city. He assigned IPS officer Sumit Sudharkar Ramteke to lead action against drug trafficking and gave him a free hand to act. Ramteke formed a special team, which started tracking the movements of suspected smugglers. Officers patrolled on scooters to monitor cocaine and marijuana dealers. The team achieved its first breakthrough on October 15, when smugglers Kunal Gupta, Arjun Singh and Manish were arrested. Police recovered 100.38 grams of marijuana and 3.45 grams of cocaine from them. Later, on October 22, Rajkumar alias Baua Lind, brother of history-sheeter Sushil Bachcha, who ran a drug syndicate in Kakadev Coaching Mandi, was arrested with 70 kg of marijuana. On January 10, 2026, police arrested five smugglers including Deepu and Deepa from Saketnagar with marijuana worth ₹2.50 crore. Officers also recovered ₹5.43 lakh in cash. Revealing the case, the Police Commissioner said the accused used to supply marijuana across the city by packing it into small packets. Even after all these revelations, the nexus of drug traffickers in the city has not completely broken. ADCP Sumit Sudhakar Ramteke said that the team was receiving information about large-scale smuggling from many places including Panki, Kakadeo, Naubasta, Machharia, Sarvodayanagar, Kalyanpur, and Nawabganj. Police would set their trap, but smugglers would escape. Officers suspected police collusion with smugglers. ADCP Sumit Sudhakar Ramteke started a secret investigation. Then suspicious numbers appeared in the CDR of some police personnel. These included numbers of one sub-inspector and three head constables. Understand how smugglers were alerted Some sent emojis, some made 3 missed calls ADCP said - Police personnel had their own distinct pattern of alerting smugglers. Some would make WhatsApp calls. Some would alert by sending emoji messages. Some would give information about police raids by making two or three missed calls. After investigation of the entire case, suspicious police personnel have been suspended. After being proven guilty, now ADCP East Anjil Vishwakarma is investigating this case.

stories.title: Scorching days ahead in UP:1st week of March hottest since 2023; temperatures likely to touch 40°C soon
stories.summary: Holi was celebrated three days ago and the effect of heat in UP has started increasing rapidly. After three years, the temperature has crossed 35 degrees Celsius in the first week of March itself. The Meteorological Department has warned that the temperature could reach 40 degrees this month. According to IMD, between March and May 2026, temperatures in most parts of the country may remain above normal. In this situation, let's find out how hot it will be this March compared to the last 5 years? Why is the heat increasing? Which sector will be affected? Read in this report... In 2025, during the first week of March, the daytime temperature in most cities of UP was recorded between 29 to 31 degrees Celsius, while the night temperature remained between approximately 14 to 19 degrees Celsius. Meanwhile, on March 1, 2026, the maximum temperature was recorded at 32.5. The beginning of March was warmer this time in UP. According to meteorological department data - on March 1, 2026, the maximum daytime temperature was recorded at 32.5 degrees Celsius, which is the highest temperature for early March in the last three years. Previously in 2023, the maximum temperature recorded on March 1 was 32 degrees Celsius. Meanwhile, in other years, the temperature on the first day of March was lower than this. Lucknow meteorologist Mohammad Danish says that such high temperatures at the beginning of March indicate that the heat could increase rapidly in the coming days. How will the weather be in coming days? According to weather expert Mohammad Danish, temperatures are likely to rise further in the coming days. Maximum temperatures could increase by about 2 to 3 degrees Celsius over the next five days. Due to this, temperatures in many areas of the state may reach around 38 degrees Celsius and the effect of strong sunlight and heat may be felt more during the day. Banda was the hottest district in the state According to Mohammad Danish, people are experiencing April-May like heat at the beginning of March itself. In the last 24 hours, Banda remained the hottest district in the state. The maximum temperature here was recorded at 35.6 degrees Celsius. Due to continuously rising temperatures, the effect of intense sunlight and heat is clearly visible during afternoon hours. Why is the temperature rising? Skymet Weather's Vice President Mahesh Palawat says that in recent years, the effect of climate change is clearly visible on weather. Due to this, the weather pattern is changing rapidly and summer is starting earlier compared to before. The impact is that now the temperature is rising more rapidly and the number of hot days is also increasing. Sometimes, the period of heat waves also lasts longer than before. In the past few years, many cities in the country have broken old heat records. In some places, temperatures have been recorded above 48 degrees Celsius. If this situation continues, the heat may feel even more intense in the coming years. Western Disturbance active, what effect will be seen in UP? According to Mahesh Palawat, a western disturbance is likely to become active, which may lead to light rain and snowfall in the Western Himalayan region (Jammu-Kashmir, Ladakh, Himachal Pradesh and Uttarakhand) between March 7 and 11. Its effect will also be seen in UP. Actually, a trough line extends up to the northern parts of Uttar Pradesh from the cyclonic circulation (air rising while rotating in a circular motion in one area) formed in the northern Odisha and Bengal region. Due to this system, there may be slight changes in the state's weather. Although the weather in Uttar Pradesh is likely to remain mostly dry for now, clouds may cover some areas and there may be slight fluctuations in temperature. Heatwave may continue for a long time According to IMD's forecast, heatwave conditions may persist for a long time in some areas this year. This means that temperatures may remain very high for several consecutive days in many cities and people may have to face intense heat. When is it considered a heatwave? According to the Weather Department, a heatwave is considered when the temperature in plains reaches 40 degrees Celsius or higher, or when the temperature recorded is 4 to 6 degrees above normal. In such conditions, people's health can be affected and the risk of heat stroke increases. Crops will be damaged due to heat Professor PK Singh from the Agriculture Department at Banaras Hindu University (BHU) says - March could prove challenging for farmers. The rise in temperature will affect the Rabi crops, especially wheat. Due to the heat, the grains will not develop fully. This will result in lower yield. According to PK Singh, hot winds can damage crops like mustard, chickpeas and peas. Rising temperatures cause soil in fields to dry quickly. This increases irrigation costs. Crops face stress.
