stories.title: Shift from traditional to technology-driven farming - UP sees surge in agricultural productivity
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh, India's breadbasket, is experiencing a dramatic agricultural transformation. Productivity has surged by over 42% since 2016-17, driven by technology, hybrid seeds, and irrigation. The state now leads in wheat and is a major producer of rice, pulses, oilseeds, and horticulture, with sugarcane remaining a vital crop. Government support and market reforms are bolstering farmer prosperity

stories.title: After World Obesity Day, study warns metabolic diseases surging across Asia-Pacific
'Exploitation': Rahul Gandhi takes 'compromised individual' dig at Centre after US waiver on Russian oil
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi criticized PM Modi's foreign policy, calling the US waiver on Russian oil purchases a result of exploiting a "compromised individual." The Congress questioned this "American blackmail," while the US stated the waiver aims to stabilize global energy amid Middle East tensions, expecting India to increase US oil imports.

stories.title: ED searches multiple sites linked to Anil Ambani’s Reliance Power in bank fraud probe
stories.summary: The Enforcement Directorate conducted searches at multiple locations in Mumbai and Hyderabad linked to Reliance Power as part of a bank fraud and money laundering probe. The investigation also involves suspected financial irregularities under the Foreign Exchange Management Act, with Anil Ambani having been questioned twice previously.

stories.title: NASA confirms: Asteroid 2024 YR4 will NOT hit the Moon in 2032 after new orbit calculations
'Kab tak chalega blackmail?': Congress slams Centre over US waiver allowing India to buy Russian oil amid Iran war
Dubai Mall visitors stunned as UAE President appears for public iftar during regional tensions
Balen Shah: Engineer, rapper, mayor, disruptor — Nepal's next PM at 35?
stories.summary: Former Kathmandu mayor and rapper Balendra Shah, known as Balen, is challenging ex-PM KP Sharma Oli in Nepal's parliamentary elections. Balen, who gained prominence through his protest songs and online following, is running on the Rastriya Swatantra Party ticket. His campaign resonates with young voters frustrated by corruption and political stagnation.

stories.title: UP urban transition after 2017 - A shift to non-agricultural economy
Two pilots killed after IAF Sukhoi Su-30 crashes in Assam’s Karbi Anglong
Khamenei killing planned in November 2025? Inside Netanyahu's 'small forum' plot
stories.summary: Israel's defence minister Katz revealed a plan to assassinate Ayatollah Khamenei was considered as early as November 2025, with the timeline accelerated due to Iran's anti-regime protests. This led to joint US-Israeli planning and a high-intensity military campaign aimed at dismantling Iran's nuclear and missile capabilities and supporting regional proxies.

stories.title: Five faces who are in the race for Bihar CM's chair
'Expect painful blows': Iran hints at 'unseen' weapons as war enters 7th day; US-Israel intensifies strikes — key points
stories.summary: The Middle East is engulfed in conflict as the US and Israel launch extensive military operations against Iran, following the death of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. Retaliatory strikes have been launched by Iran, targeting US bases, while both sides report significant military actions, including the destruction of an Iranian "drone carrier" and damage to schools.

stories.title: 'Khamenei's son is a lightweight': Trump shares Iran war update, insists US should have role in choosing next leader
stories.summary: Amid escalating West Asian tensions and ongoing US-Israeli strikes, President Trump stated Iran is seeking a deal, but "a little bit late." He asserted that Operation Epic Fury is decimating Iran's military capabilities, claiming significant damage to its Air Force and Navy.

stories.title: Amit Shah unveils mascots ‘Pragati’ and ‘Vikas’ for India’s first digital Census
stories.summary: Home Minister Amit Shah launched four digital tools and two mascots for India's first digital Census 2027. The initiative includes a self-enumeration portal allowing citizens to submit household information online in 16 languages, aiming for accuracy and inclusivity in the world's largest census exercise.

stories.title: When 7 rays hit cinemas in land of rising sun
stories.summary: Satyajit Ray's filmography is capturing hearts anew in Japan, as a stunning showcase of seven of his works pulls in enthusiastic audiences. With unforgettable classics like 'Charulata' and 'Mahanagar' now drawing such a response, the screenings have been extended to accommodate fans, paving the way for a Blu-ray release.

stories.title: Pakistan left with 26 days of fuel, may impose work-from-home as Strait of Hormuz crisis deepens
stories.summary: Pakistan is implementing major measures to ensure fuel stability amid trade slowdown due to the Strait of Hormuz closure. Proposals include weekly price revisions, compensation for increased oil company costs, and fuel conservation. The country is exploring alternative import routes and has substantial existing fuel stocks.

stories.title: Iran using cluster bomb warheads in ongoing conflict: Israel military
stories.summary: Iran has reportedly deployed ballistic missiles armed with cluster bomb warheads against Israel, scattering numerous small explosives over wide areas. This tactic, confirmed by the IDF, significantly increases the risk of civilian casualties and infrastructure damage. Unexploded submunitions pose a lingering threat, acting like landmines. Several countries, including India, have not signed the international ban on these weapons.

stories.title: Why Iran's global partners are staying on the sidelines
stories.summary: Iran's long-standing allies, including Turkiye, India, China, and Russia, are offering little more than words as the Islamic Republic faces attacks. These relationships, largely transactional and driven by necessity, lack the deep commitments needed for mutual defense. Experts suggest Iran's foreign policy, focused on militias rather than state alliances, has left it isolated when facing direct threats.

stories.title: Dubai Police bust 'luxury car beggar', arrest 37 beggars of various nationalities amid crackdown
stories.summary: Dubai Police are cracking down on beggars during Ramadan. Authorities have arrested dozens of people exploiting the holy month's charitable spirit. This crackdown is part of an annual campaign to prevent illegal solicitation. Similar efforts are underway across the UAE. Residents are urged to donate through official charities to ensure aid reaches those truly in need.

stories.title: Flights resume at Abu Dhabi's Zayed International Airport: What travellers must know now amid Iran-US-Israel war
stories.summary: Abu Dhabi's Zayed International Airport has resumed limited flight operations, offering relief to thousands of stranded passengers after days of severe travel disruptions amid Iran-US-Israel war. This cautious reopening follows widespread flight suspensions triggered by escalating geopolitical tensions, with authorities prioritizing passenger safety and operational readiness during the gradual recovery.

stories.title: India's 'moist heatwaves' getting worse, says study
stories.summary: 'Rossby Waves' Arising Off Europe Coast Key Trigger

stories.title: STs following Hindu customs can't be excluded from Hindu marriage law: High court
stories.summary: Scheduled Tribe members adhering to Hindu customs are not barred from the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, Chhattisgarh High Court ruled. The court set aside a family court's rejection of a mutual divorce petition, stating that those who voluntarily follow Hindu rites cannot be excluded.

stories.title: UAE opens ‘safe air corridors’: Airlines allowed 48 flights per hour amid Middle East tensions
stories.summary: The UAE has opened 'safe air corridors' allowing up to 48 flights hourly to stabilise regional aviation amidst geopolitical tensions and the Iran-US-Israel war. This initiative aims to restore connectivity, evacuate thousands of stranded passengers and support tourism and business sectors. Limited commercial services have resumed, with authorities planning further phases to clear the backlog.

stories.title: Bihar: JDU cadre bet on Nishant to fill in father Nitish Kumar's shoes
stories.summary: Bihar's ruling party, JDU, anticipates Nishant Kumar's political debut as his father, Nitish Kumar, prepares to step down. This move aims to reassure party workers and maintain the JDU's traditional support base, particularly among the Kurmi community. Nishant, an engineering graduate, is reportedly being considered for a Deputy Chief Minister role, signaling continuity as Nitish shifts to the Rajya Sabha.

stories.title: Nitish Kumar a wily strategist who made CM seat his own
stories.summary: Nitish Kumar exits Bihar CM post after two decades, sparking political upheaval. Known for his strategic alliances and ideological shifts, Kumar carved a unique niche as an OBC leader focusing on "Mandal-plus" policies and women's welfare. His political maneuvering, including caste-based strategies and welfarism, sustained his dominance for years.

stories.title: Dubai's KHDA moves Indian schools to distance learning till term end amid US-Israel war on Iran
stories.summary: Dubai's education regulator has extended distance learning for Indian curriculum schools until the end of the academic term. This decision, impacting CBSE and ICSE students, is a precautionary measure amid regional security concerns due to the Iran-Israel-US war. The new academic year will commence on April 6, 2026, ensuring continuity and safety for thousands of students.

stories.title: 'Hasn't taken a day off in 25 years': Mark Carney praises PM Modi's work ethic
stories.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney lauded Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi's dedication to citizen welfare. Carney highlighted Modi's focus on direct delivery of programs to ordinary Indians. He also noted Modi's relentless work ethic, stating he has not taken a day off in 25 years. Carney's remarks followed recent meetings aimed at strengthening bilateral ties.

stories.title: Gulf conflict: LNG squeeze may impact urea output ahead of kharif season
stories.summary: India's fertilizer supply faces potential disruptions for the upcoming kharif season if the Strait of Hormuz blockade persists. While current stocks are healthy, reduced LNG imports for urea production could impact output. Rising global prices due to shipping route blockades may also increase government subsidy expenses.

stories.title: Over 60% turnout as Nepal votes in 'historic' polls powered by Gen Z
stories.summary: Nepal's Gen Z voters turned out in large numbers for snap parliamentary elections, a significant development following September protests that reshaped the country's politics. Despite logistical challenges in the mountainous nation, preliminary turnout exceeded 60%, with young activists viewing election day as the next phase of their movement for change and accountability.

stories.title: Abu Dhabi on edge: 6 injured as drone debris from Iran and US-Israel conflict crashes into industrial zone
stories.summary: Six people were injured in Abu Dhabi by falling drone debris after air defences intercepted projectiles amid escalating Iran-Israel-US tensions. This incident highlights the risks of falling fragments even during successful interceptions. The UAE is urging residents to stay informed and follow safety advisories as regional conflicts spill into civilian areas.

stories.title: Middle East tensions: PM Modi, Emmanuel Macron discuss need for dialogue & diplomacy
stories.summary: Prime Minister Modi held discussions with French President Macron, emphasizing a return to dialogue and diplomacy for the West Asia region. Both leaders committed to close engagement and coordinated efforts to restore peace and stability. Concurrently, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar engaged with his counterparts from Saudi Arabia and Oman, underscoring India's active diplomatic outreach.

stories.title: India finally condoles killing of Iran's Khamenei; foreign ministers talk
stories.summary: Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri signed a condolence book at the Iranian embassy following the killing of Iran's supreme leader, amid criticism over India's initial silence. This move follows a telephonic conversation between External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar and his Iranian counterpart, with a potential high-level meeting scheduled.

stories.title: 'Always wished to be in both Houses': Nitish Kumar files Rajya Sabha papers
stories.summary: Nitish Kumar filed for Rajya Sabha, signaling a potential end to his Bihar CM tenure despite family and party objections. His move, supported by Amit Shah, has sparked unrest within JD(U), with workers protesting. Discussions within NDA are underway for a successor, possibly a Dalit leader or JD(U) deputy CM, as RJD criticizes the political maneuvering.

stories.title: Who is Zobaidul Amin? Bangladeshi national arrested in US over global child exploitation charges
Rajya Sabha polls: Political tie-ups against NDA face acid test in Bihar, Odisha
stories.summary: Rajya Sabha nominations have set the stage for political contests in Bihar and Odisha, with new alignments tested. While Maharashtra's NCP factions remain divided, the BJP-led NDA is strategically nominating diverse candidates to broaden its social coalition.

stories.title: Young GOP activists used racial slurs, discussed killing Black Americans in WhatsApp chat: Report
stories.summary: A WhatsApp group of young Republicans, led by a local party secretary, reportedly featured hundreds of racial slurs and discussions of murdering Black Americans. Members also hurled antisemitic and misogynistic insults. The group's activities are now under criminal investigation, with party leadership calling for immediate resignations.

stories.title: UAE emergency alert: 5 things to do, one to never do if you see falling shrapnel or missile debris amid US-Israel war on Iran
stories.summary: Missile interceptions are now a reality for Gulf residents. Fragments from intercepted threats are falling, causing injuries and damage. Authorities in the UAE are issuing crucial safety advice. Residents must stay calm, move away from debris, seek shelter indoors and report any findings immediately. Never touch or approach suspicious objects. Official updates are vital for safety during these uncertain times.

stories.title: High court fails to deliver verdict for 6 years, Supreme Court shifts case to itself
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has taken the unprecedented step of transferring three petitions from the Allahabad High Court to itself, citing a six-year delay in delivering a verdict on a 1994 criminal case. This intervention, aimed at ensuring speedy justice, highlights concerns over the High Court's prolonged inaction, which has also kept the trial stayed.

stories.title: Major reshuffle in Raj Bhavans: Ex-envoy Sandhu named Delhi LG, Tamil Nadu Governor Ravi moved to Bengal
stories.summary: A significant gubernatorial reshuffle has seen R N Ravi appointed as West Bengal's new governor, replacing C V Ananda Bose. This move, occurring just before state elections, has drawn sharp criticism from Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee. Taranjit Singh Sandhu is set to become the new L-G of Delhi, among other key appointments across various states and Union Territories.

stories.title: ‘Dear Indians targeting me...': Whistleblower claims spam calls after he ‘exposed’ H-1B ‘takeover’
Courts must deal with disobedient litigants with an iron hand: Supreme Court
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has strongly condemned government authorities and litigants for routinely defying court orders and resorting to delayed appeals when facing contempt. Justices Ahsanuddin Amanullah and R Mahadevan emphasized that such practices erode public faith in the judiciary, urging strict action against disobedient parties, especially state entities, to uphold the rule of law.

stories.title: Who is Markwayne Mullin? Trump’s DHS secretary choice after firing Kristi Noem
IRIS Dena sinks: Blaming India for US strike on Iran frigate illogical, says BJP
stories.summary: The BJP has strongly refuted claims blaming India for a US strike on an Iranian naval vessel, emphasizing the incident occurred in international waters far from Indian jurisdiction. Party leader Amit Malviya stated that geographical proximity does not equate to control or accountability under international maritime law, dismissing attempts to involve India as factually incorrect and politically motivated speculation.

stories.title: Blanket row, open-secret affair, $220 million ad campaign: Why Trump fired Kristi Noem
Iran crisis: Rahul Gandhi questions PM Modi's 'silence' on warship sinking in 'our backyard'
stories.summary: Congress leaders Rahul Gandhi and Mallikarjun Kharge criticized Prime Minister Narendra Modi's silence on the "conflict" and the sinking of an Iranian warship. They accused the government of "surrendering strategic sovereignty" and "undoing" India's foreign policy, particularly concerning oil imports and the safety of Indian citizens in the Gulf region.

stories.title: UAE shocked as fruit and vegetable prices rise amid US-Israel war on Iran: What shoppers need to know
stories.summary: UAE shoppers are facing rising fruit and vegetable prices, attributed to geopolitical tensions amid Iran-US-Israel war, impacting shipping and air freight. Despite stable supply chains, increased fuel, transport and insurance costs are pushing up prices for perishable goods. While authorities assure food security remains strong, consumers may see continued price fluctuations.

stories.title: No issue can be resolved just through conflict: PM Modi meets Finnish President Alexander Stubb; calls for Ukraine peace
stories.summary: India and Finland emphasized that ending the Russia-Ukraine war is crucial for global stability and called for UN reform. Both nations agreed to support a just peace in Ukraine through diplomacy. A new Migration and Mobility Agreement was signed, fostering cooperation in technology, defense, and critical minerals, strengthening bilateral ties and global supply chains.

stories.title: Trump ousts Kristi Noem as DHS secretary, taps Senator Markwayne Mullin as replacement
Jammu & Kashmir cricket association scam: Farooq Abdullah gets relief from ED
stories.summary: A Srinagar court has rejected the Enforcement Directorate's bid to add charges against Dr. Farooq Abdullah and others in the JKCA scam. While the ED cannot join the existing CBI case, the court found prima facie evidence of criminal conspiracy and breach of trust.

stories.title: Efforts on to evacuated Kashmiri students from Iran: Farooq and Omar Abdullah
stories.summary: Jammu and Kashmir authorities are coordinating with the Centre to bring back students, primarily medical students, stranded in Iran. Officials are facilitating peaceful expressions of condolences while urging against exploiting the situation. Internet services have been restricted in Kashmir ahead of planned protests. Efforts are underway to evacuate students to safer locations within Iran before flying them home.

stories.title: 'Have to be involved in appointment of next Iranian leader': Trump calls Khamenei's son Mojtaba 'unacceptable', 'lightweight'
stories.summary: President Trump declared he will personally select Iran's next leader, deeming Ali Khamenei's son, Mojtaba, "unacceptable." Trump stated he must be involved in the appointment, comparing it to Venezuela, to ensure a leader who brings peace, not war. This comes amid a US military campaign targeting Iran's capabilities, not regime change.

stories.title: US asked Ukraine for help against Iranian drones in Middle East, says Zelenskyy
stories.summary: Ukraine has agreed to share its expertise and interceptor drone technology to help the US counter Iranian attacks in the Middle East. President Zelenskyy emphasized that this assistance will only be provided if it doesn't compromise Ukraine's own defense and strengthens diplomatic ties. He also suggested a potential drone-for-missile swap with Gulf allies.

stories.title: BEL, Bellatrix ink pact to develop very low Earth orbit satellite systems
stories.summary: Defence electronics major Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) has partnered with space technology startup Bellatrix Aerospace to jointly develop and manufacture satellite systems, focusing on the emerging very low Earth orbit (VLEO) regime. This collaboration aims to combine BEL's electronics expertise with Bellatrix's propulsion technology to create next-generation satellite platforms for both strategic and civilian space missions.

stories.title: Trump ‘furious’ after Kristi Noem claims he approved $220 million DHS ad campaign: Report
stories.summary: Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem's testimony about a $220 million ad campaign, featuring her face and reportedly approved by President Trump, has sparked White House fury. Senator John Kennedy questioned the approval process, leading to reports of Trump considering Noem's replacement, with Markwayne Mullin's name surfacing. Noem also faced scrutiny over contracts and her association with Corey Lewandowski.

stories.title: '7,000 Indian flown home in 3 days; more flights over 48 hours'
Indian-origin owner of Virginia grocery store pleads guilty to food stamp fraud: 'Cash for SNAP'
PM Modi to launch key DMRC projects on March 8
Big governor reshuffle: Rashtrapati Bhavan issues orders for changes across 9 states and UTs - full list
stories.summary: A significant reshuffling of governors and Lieutenant governors across several states and Union Territories, including Delhi, Ladakh, and West Bengal, was announced by Rashtrapati Bhavan. Key appointments include Taranjit Singh Sandhu as Delhi's new LG and Vinai Kumar Saxena moving to Ladakh. Several other states like Telangana, Maharashtra, Bihar, Himachal Pradesh, and Nagaland also saw new gubernatorial assignments.

stories.title: $20K drones vs $4m US missiles: How Iran is managing to hit targets across Middle East
stories.summary: A new conflict between the US and Iran is unfolding. Iran is deploying inexpensive drones, forcing the US and its allies to use costly interceptor missiles. This creates a significant economic imbalance. The war is becoming a battle of endurance, testing which side can sustain its weapon supplies longer.

stories.title: Iran’s legendary King Cyrus the Great: The man who conquered the world 2,500 years ago and fulfilled ancient predictions
'White skin gives immunity...': Old post of James Talarico triggers row; 'bigger evil than Jasmine Crockett'
“Which ocean”: IShowSpeed plans livestream search after Eiichiro Oda drops One Piece mystery treasure box into the sea
stories.summary: IShowSpeed reacted to a One Piece celebration video where creator Eiichiro Oda dropped a box containing the story’s secret into the ocean. During his March 4, 2026 livestream, the streamer said he wanted to search for it live. Meanwhile, a Reddit user analyzed the video and suggested Suruga Bay in Japan could be the possible location.

stories.title: End of Lalu-Nitish era in Bihar: BJP all set to conquer final frontier of Hindi heartland
Missing Sukhoi-30 MKI crashed 60 km from Assam’s Jorhat after takeoff; search ops under way
stories.summary: A Sukhoi Su-30 fighter jet of the Indian Air Force crashed in Assam's Karbi Anglong district during a training sortie. The aircraft had lost radar contact shortly after departing from Jorhat. Search operations are currently in progress to locate the jet and its crew. This incident involves a key multirole fighter in the IAF's extensive fleet.

stories.title: Venezuela to sell up to 1,000 kg of gold to US markets in new deal: Report
stories.summary: Venezuela's Minerven has signed a multimillion-dollar contract with Trafigura to sell 650-1,000 kg of gold dore bars to the US. US Interior Secretary Doug Burgum facilitated the deal, which involves gold being sent to US refineries. This marks a significant tightening of commercial ties between the US and Venezuela.

stories.title: Britney Spears arrested in California on suspicion of drunk driving, court date set for May 4
'Responded to distress call, rescue op ongoing': India on Iran ship sunk by US off Sri Lanka coast
‘I made a mistake’: Rep. Tony Gonzales admits affair with staffer who later died by suicide amid ethics investigation
stories.summary: Rep. Tony Gonzales admitted to a sexual relationship with a staffer who died by suicide, hours after the House Ethics Committee launched an investigation. Gonzales stated he made a mistake and takes full responsibility, while also facing a runoff election after failing to secure a majority in the Texas primary.

stories.title: Ladakh Lieutenant governor Kavinder Gupta resigns after just nine months in office: Report
Ahead of Bengal polls, governor CV Ananda Bose resigns; RN Ravi set to take over, says Mamata Banerjee
Embassies shut, travel restricted: What to do if your US visa is expiring
Afghanistan, Iraq, Iran and beyond: Tracking US strikes across the world since 2001
stories.summary: Since 9/11, the US has engaged in extensive military actions across at least 10 countries, including full-scale wars and drone campaigns. These interventions, part of the "war on terror," have resulted in nearly a million deaths and trillions of dollars spent, reshaping American foreign policy for over two decades.

stories.title: Sushasan, switches and survival: End of an era in Bihar as Nitish Kumar moves to Rajya Sabha
stories.summary: Bihar's longest-serving Chief Minister, Nitish Kumar, has filed his nomination for the Rajya Sabha, marking a significant political shift. After over two decades in power, Kumar's move, announced via social media, has surprised many within his party and political circles, signaling the end of an era in state politics.

stories.title: Who is Tim Sheehy? Senator who helped officers remove ex-Navy SEAL from Senate hearing
The mystery of the Babushka Lady: The unidentified woman linked to John F. Kennedy’s assassination
TechGig announces ‘she builds the future 2026’: A high-impact leadership initiative redefining the technology landscape
stories.summary: TechGig launches "She Builds the Future: Power, Presence & Progress," a virtual leadership summit on March 7-8, 2026. The event features global women leaders discussing leadership in AI, automation, and hybrid work, focusing on building high-performance teams and driving business outcomes. An exclusive podcast on March 16th will explore women's roles in the AI shift.

stories.title: Former Marine’s anti-Iran war protest sparks clash: Did Senator Tim Sheehy break Brian McGinnis’ arm?
stories.summary: A protestor's anti-war outburst disrupted a Senate hearing, leading to a scuffle and injuries to three police officers. Brian McGinnis, identified as a Green Party candidate, was forcibly removed after shouting against military action in Iran. Senator Tim Sheehy assisted in the removal, stating he aimed to de-escalate the situation. McGinnis was arrested.

stories.title: 'Since he is an Indian…’: Laura Loomer says Kash Patel is ‘owned by Muslims’ over Austin bar shooting
Mysterious fireball, sonic boom in Vancouver: Nasa confirms it was a meteor traveling at 33 kmps speed
Science behind the lab-grown diamonds: How centuries of failed experiments led to affordable gems
Evening news brief: India condoles Khamenei’s death; Nitish Kumar files Rajya Sabha nomination and more
stories.summary: India extended condolences on Iran's Supreme Leader's passing while PM Modi engaged Gulf leaders amid rising regional tensions. Bihar CM Nitish Kumar filed for Rajya Sabha, signaling a leadership shift. Indian markets surged as global sentiment improved.

stories.title: Holi celebrations reflect Uttarakhand's culture, faith, and development: CM Dhami
'We are going to fulfil this demand': Delhi CM Rekha Gupta lays foundation stone for new foot overbridge at ISBT
India condoles Khamenei's death; EAM Jaishankar speaks to Iran's FM, foreign secretary meets Tehran envoy
stories.summary: India has formally expressed condolences for the death of Iran's Supreme Leader, with the Foreign Secretary visiting the Iranian Embassy. Amidst escalating regional tensions, Prime Minister Modi has engaged in extensive diplomatic outreach, speaking with leaders of several Gulf nations and Israel. These discussions focused on regional security and the welfare of the large Indian diaspora.

stories.title: US-Israel war with Iran: Why various Gulf countries are angry with the UK and Keir Starmer
NASA seeks cost-effective solution for the Artemis Moon mission with Boeing-Lockheed component
Census 2027: Amit Shah unveils mascots ‘Pragati’ and ‘Vikas’; what’s new this time
‘Nirantar’ Nitish turns a new page, set for Rajya Sabha after decades as Bihar CM
stories.summary: Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar is stepping down after leading the NDA to a significant victory, opting to move to the Rajya Sabha. This marks a major political shift for the veteran leader, opening the door for the BJP to potentially appoint its own chief minister in the state.

stories.title: 'Conflict has reached our backyard': Rahul Gandhi targets Centre after Iranian warship sunk in Indian Ocean
SpaceX rocket launch creates ‘space jellyfish’ effect in Florida sky during Falcon 9 mission carrying 29 Starlink satellites
Meet Evelyn N. Wang: The scientist who wants to make every home produce its own water
Joseph Kony still alive: Know how Uganda’s most infamous war criminal has stayed on the run for decades with his soldiers
With Amit Shah by his side, Bihar CM Nitish Kumar files nomination for Rajya Sabha
stories.summary: Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar filed his Rajya Sabha nomination today, accompanied by Union Home Minister Amit Shah. This move follows his decision to step down and head to Parliament, fulfilling a long-held aspiration. The transition, occurring after a recent election victory, signals a potential shift in Bihar's leadership within the NDA.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia opens Hajj packages booking for domestic pilgrims with strict payment timeline
Dubai Crown Prince Sheikh Hamdan orders early salary payment for government employees ahead of Eid Al Fitr
UAE announces early spring break for schools and universities: Dates, classes resumption, all you need to know
stories.summary: UAE schools and universities will observe an early spring break from March 9 to March 22, 2026. This extended holiday, confirmed by the Ministry of Education and Ministry of Higher Education, applies to all public and private institutions, including students, teaching, and administrative staff. Classes and official duties will resume on Monday, March 23, 2026.

stories.title: Middle East crisis: Is US using Indian ports to strike Iran? MEA fact-checks claim
‘No more nepotism, bootlicking’: Nepal votes a year after violent Gen Z protest; key things to know
Rockets, missiles and drones fly across Iran and Israel; Middle East remains tense — how the war is unfolding
stories.summary: Escalating Middle East conflict sees Israel strike Lebanon and intercept Iranian missiles. A US submarine sank an Iranian warship, while Iran retaliated with strikes across the region. The US Senate backed President Trump's military actions against Iran. Energy supplies are threatened as oil prices soar and global markets react.

stories.title: Indian expat in Sharjah turns millionaire overnight: Wins Dh15 million in Abu Dhabi Big Ticket draw
stories.summary: A Sharjah-based expatriate, Vibeesh Palliyali, has won the Dh15 million grand prize in the Big Ticket Abu Dhabi raffle draw. Palliyali purchased his winning ticket just days before the Series 284 live draw. This win highlights the life-altering potential of the popular monthly lottery, resonating with expatriate communities across the UAE.

stories.title: Mass visa relief in the UAE: Overstay fines dropped for tourists affected by flight chaos amid Iran and US–Israel war
stories.summary: The UAE's Federal Authority for Identity and Citizenship has waived overstay fines for tourists and residents stranded by flight cancellations and airspace closures due to regional conflict. This humanitarian measure eases financial and bureaucratic burdens for thousands of travellers unable to depart the country, reflecting a flexible approach to travel policy during crises.

stories.title: US-Israel-Iran War Live Updates: Tanker hit by ‘large explosion’ off Kuwait, causing oil spill; Iran launches missiles at Israel
UAE slams Bloomberg over ‘inaccurate’ air defence report amid US–Israel war on Iran
stories.summary: The UAE has strongly refuted a Bloomberg report questioning its air defence capabilities, calling the claims false and misleading. Asserting its possession of diverse, multi-layered systems and robust munitions, the ministry stressed its unwavering operational readiness. This strong rebuttal highlights the nation's commitment to controlling its security narrative amidst regional tensions and calls for responsible journalism.

stories.title: PIO diplomat criticises UK foreign office for being woke, quits
stories.summary: A senior British diplomat of Indian origin has resigned, citing the Foreign Office's 'woke' culture and an overemphasis on international law at the expense of national security. Ameer Kotecha criticized the handling of issues like the Chagos Islands and Iran, arguing for a more Britain-first approach. He described the civil service as inefficient and out of touch with national priorities.

stories.title: Saudia extends flight suspensions until March 6: 8 destinations affected amid Iran-US–Israel conflict
stories.summary: Saudia has extended flight suspensions to eight key destinations until March 6, 2026. This decision stems from ongoing regional tensions and airspace closures due to US–Israel–Iran conflict, impacting commercial air travel. The airline is contacting affected passengers directly. Travellers are advised to verify flight status before heading to the airport. Other regional carriers also face similar disruptions.

stories.title: Oxford museum set to return 500-year-old bronze statue taken from Tamil Nadu temple
stories.summary: A 16th-century bronze statue of Saint Tirumankai Alvar, taken from a Tamil Nadu temple, is returning to India from the UK. Acquired by the Ashmolean Museum in 1967, its provenance became questionable after a 2019 discovery. Following an investigation and a formal claim by India, the museum has agreed to its repatriation, highlighting a commitment to ethical collections.

stories.title: Middle East crisis: Trump rates US war effort ‘15 out of 10’; vows to push on against Iran
stories.summary: US President Trump declared the campaign against Iran "about a 15" on a scale of 10, citing success in decimating Iranian leadership and missile capabilities. He reiterated the goal of preventing nuclear weapons, vowing to continue joint operations with Israel despite escalating regional conflict, rising oil prices, and domestic criticism.

stories.title: Indian-origin elderly couple loses £2,500 in fake flight ticket fraud at Heathrow: 'Don’t know how scammers got our number'
Arkansas father accused of killing daughter’s alleged rapist wins GOP nomination for sheriff
stories.summary: An Arkansas father, awaiting trial for allegedly killing his daughter's accused sexual predator, has won the Republican nomination for county sheriff. Aaron Spencer defeated the incumbent, securing over 53% of the vote.

stories.title: What is Indian-American Voter Atlas? Political strategist launches tool to track diaspora
West Asia crisis: 1,500 flights cancelled in four days, Air India to add capacity on key long routes
stories.summary: Airlines are intensifying evacuation efforts with special flights as Middle East air travel disruptions continue for the fourth day. Indian carriers planned 58 flights on Wednesday, with IndiGo and Air India increasing capacity on long-haul routes. Airports in Dubai and Abu Dhabi are handling limited repatriation flights, while services in Bahrain, Doha, and Kuwait remain suspended.

stories.title: UAE flights resume but not fully: 5 airlines begin limited services amid Iran–US–Israel conflict
stories.summary: UAE airlines are operating limited flights amid regional airspace closures due to escalating Iran-US-Israel tensions. Authorities are using emergency corridors to resume services cautiously, prioritizing stranded passengers. Most regular flights remain suspended, with airlines extending cancellations as safety assessments continue. Travelers are urged to verify flight status before heading to airports.

stories.title: Nitish Kumar heads for Rajya Sabha, paves way for BJP CM in Bihar
stories.summary: To File Nomination In Patna Today In Shah's Presence

stories.title: Mars once had beaches like Earth: Radar data is revealing the buried shoreline
Indian-origin boss of England and Wales police federation, Mukund Krishna, arrested on suspicion of corruption
Stocks empty or strategic move? Iran firing fewer missiles, says top US General
stories.summary: Iran's missile and drone attacks have significantly decreased, according to US military chief General Dan Caine. Despite this, Washington is expanding its offensive deeper into Iranian territory. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth declared the US is winning, highlighting a submarine sinking an Iranian warship. The conflict has widened regionally, causing displacement and economic shockwaves.

stories.title: 41 sealed ballots found at home: Pakistani immigrant sentenced for election fraud in California
'Is it still America or Israel first': Iran's Ali Larijani accuses Trump of dragging US in 'unfair war'
stories.summary: Iran's top security official, Ali Larijani, accused President Trump of initiating an "unfair war" and vowed retaliation for the reported killing of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. Larijani stated Iran will not negotiate with Washington amid escalating regional conflict, questioning Trump's "America First" policy after significant US troop casualties.

stories.title: Attack motivated by Pakistani background: Afghan national assaults neighbour in New York in alleged hate crime
Dubai under tension? Indian TV star Erica Fernandes shares on-ground reality from UAE emirate amid Iran-US-Israel clashes, sparks debate
stories.summary: Indian TV actor Erica J Fernandes shared a Dubai video featuring intercepted aerial threats alongside confident UAE rulers, captioned 'Habibi you're still welcome to Dubai.' Her clarification emphasised her personal experience of safety and efficient handling of regional tensions amid Iran and US-Israel clashes, sparking debate on social media's role in portraying geopolitical realities.

stories.title: 'AI wife' professed love to 36-year-old Florida man, then drove him to suicide; lawsuit filed against Google Gemini
World’s largest acidic geyser erupts after 6 years, sending 30-foot blasts across Yellowstone
Who is Mothin Ali? Why is the Green Party leader fighting with Keir Starmer?
stories.summary: Leeds councillor Mothin Ali, Green Party co-deputy leader, faces controversy over statements on Israel and international conflicts. His 2023 tweet about "white supremacist European settler colonialism" and a 2025 remark calling an IDF-serving rabbi an "animal" drew sharp criticism. A 2026 parliamentary clash with PM Keir Starmer further intensified scrutiny.

stories.title: ‘I have seen the missile’: Indian woman from first evacuation flight recounts tense days in Dubai
stories.summary: An Indian national returning from Dubai described scenes of panic, missile alerts, and sleepless nights as regional tensions escalated. Saumya Khandelwal recounted witnessing missile activity and emergency alarms, forcing her to seek shelter in a hotel basement. Despite the fear, she highlighted the cooperation of authorities and locals in Dubai, and the support from the Indian Embassy.

stories.title: 'Natural increase to hit zero': Immigration could soon drive 100% of Canada’s population growth, says expert
Indian-origin Pooja Sethi, who stood up to defend her Indian heritage, wins Democratic primary for Texas House District 47
AI war videos and hacked handles: X head of product Nikita Bier uncovers 31-account operation
stories.summary: X has suspended accounts run from Pakistan that shared AI-generated war videos, impersonating "Iran War Monitor" and "IDF Girl" profiles. The platform is implementing stricter rules, including a 90-day suspension from its creator revenue-sharing program for undisclosed AI-generated conflict content, to combat misinformation amid the Iran war.

stories.title: 'US, Israel will have complete control of Iran skies in few days,' says Pentagon chief
Application & approval process for access roads from NHs goes fully digital
Who is Manu Raju? Indian-American journalist who faced off with Marco Rubio on US-Iran conflict
Road ministry proposes Centre’s authority to set speed limits for NHs
'Deport': Indian-American Sohali Vaddula trolled after she says she voted for James Talarico in Texas Dem primary
‘Risking lives for distraction’: Deployed US service military member’s wife criticizes Iran strikes
stories.summary: The wife of a deployed US service member expressed concern that the Trump administration's strikes on Iran felt like a dangerous distraction. She stated that many service members believe the actions are intended to deflect from domestic issues rather than protect Americans, risking lives for political purposes.

stories.title: IISc, Pratiksha Trust launch ‘Moonshot’ project on brain co-processors
28 seats and a Rajya Sabha berth: Congress seals Tamil Nadu poll pact with DMK
Give birth to your next child: US ambassador's 'awkward' joke to embassy staff amid Iran war; 'If it's a boy..'
Texas primary election rigged': Jasmine Crockett after losing race to Rep James Talarico
stories.summary: Representative Jasmine Crockett alleged Republicans attempted to rig her primary race after the Texas Supreme Court ruled against extending polling hours in Dallas County. The court mandated that votes cast after the initial closing time be separated, a decision Democrats argued disenfranchised voters amid confusion over Republican-led polling location changes.

stories.title: Bihar CM Nitish Kumar likely to head to Rajya Sabha: JDU sources
stories.summary: The Election Commission of India (ECI) has announced the schedule for the upcoming biennial elections to the Council of States (Rajya Sabha) to fill 37 seats across 10 states, as the terms of the current members end in April 2026, according to a press note. The seats are set to fall vacant as the terms of members elected from Maharashtra, Odisha, Tamil Nadu, West Bengal, Assam, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh and Telangana conclude next month.

stories.title: Indians too much more patriotic than whites: Row over '100% Indian Boy Scouts' at Frisco Council meeting
Congress backs Sharad Pawar for Rajya Sabha, MVA closes ranks in Maharashtra
Khamenei's farewell ceremony postponed as US, Israel-Iran conflict intensifies on Day 5
Jasmine Crockett out of Congress? MAGA celebrates as she loses Texas primary to James Talarico
Canada announces $100 million scholarships for Indian students, introduces 'hybrid study locations'
‘Very alarming’: Laura Loomer says she feels ‘unsafe’ seeing Muslim workers at US airport amid Iran war
stories.summary: Far-right activist Laura Loomer expressed feeling "unsafe" due to the number of Muslim workers at US airports, citing her experience in Atlanta. She questioned why Muslims are employed as TSA agents and airport staff, stating her belief that there are "too many Muslims in America.

stories.title: Evening news wrap: Khamenei's funeral postponed, BLA executes 7 Pakistan soldiers & more
'I feel abandoned': Indian-American CEO stranded in Dubai says India rescuing citizens but US doing nothing
UAE travel alert: Air Arabia extends flight suspension to March 9, what travellers need to know
Sealed for 2,600 years, Italy’s ancient tomb finally opened to reveal jewellery, ritual vessels and human remains
“Erika scam a genius like Charlie”: Candace Owens’ explanation about Charlie Kirk’s relationship choices sparks controversy
stories.summary: Candace Owens’ comments about Charlie Kirk’s relationship with Erika Kirk have sparked online backlash after journalist Natalie Jean Beisner criticized her remarks. Owens argued that intelligence does not prevent people from making mistakes in relationships. Critics say the discussion is insensitive given Kirk’s death, while supporters believe Owens was explaining how emotions can cloud judgment.

stories.title: Senior Journalist and Padma Bhushan awardee HK Dua passes away at 88
Russian shadow fleet LNG tanker sinks after 'sudden explosions' off Libya coast
Saudi Arabia announces Eid Al Fitr 2026 public holidays for government and private sectors
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia has officially announced the Eid Al Fitr 2026 public holidays for government, private, and non-profit sectors. The break for private and non-profit employees begins March 18, 2026, lasting four days. The exact start of Eid depends on the crescent moon sighting, with official confirmation to follow.

stories.title: Relief to vehicle owners, hypothecation removal now to be online
stories.summary: Vehicle owners can now rejoice as hypothecation removal from registration certificates becomes automatic post-loan repayment. The road transport ministry's new online system, launched with select banks and NBFCs, eliminates manual visits to RTOs. This seamless process, leveraging RBI's ULI, ensures real-time data exchange, simplifying loan closure for citizens.

stories.title: 'Such a scary time': How stranded passengers in Dubai used cabs, cash and detours to flee Iran crisis
stories.summary: Middle East air travel is severely disrupted following joint US-Israeli strikes on Iran and subsequent missile attacks. Thousands are stranded, resorting to overland journeys and expensive last-minute flights. Expatriates in Dubai face uncertainty, with some companies relocating staff. Despite escalating tensions, daily life in parts of the UAE continues with an air of normalcy.

stories.title: 'Target for elimination': Israel's warning for Iran's next supreme leader
stories.summary: Israel has warned that any successor to Iran's Supreme Leader will be a target for elimination, vowing to crush the regime's capabilities. This declaration follows the reported killing of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei and the potential selection of his son, Mojtaba Khamenei, as his successor. The IDF is preparing for further actions amid ongoing airstrikes against Hezbollah and Iranian security sites.

stories.title: India sets up control room, issues helpline number amid Middle East crisis
stories.summary: Amid escalating West Asia tensions, India's Ministry of External Affairs has established a special control room to assist its citizens residing in the region. The government is closely monitoring the evolving situation and remains in contact with regional governments and international partners to ensure the safety of nearly one crore Indians living there.

stories.title: Qatar Airways extends flight suspension amid continued airspace closure
stories.summary: Qatar Airways has halted all flights due to the closure of Qatari airspace. Passengers are awaiting updates as authorities determine when it's safe to resume operations. The airline will restart services only after official clearance. The next update is scheduled for March 6th at 9 AM Doha time.

stories.title: UAE residents return home on 3 exceptional Etihad Rail trains from Saudi border
stories.summary: Etihad Rail, typically a freight operator, deployed three exceptional passenger services to safely transport UAE citizens and residents from the Saudi border to Abu Dhabi. This emergency mission, coordinated with Abu Dhabi authorities, demonstrated the railway's readiness as a critical pillar of national emergency response infrastructure during regional travel disruptions.

stories.title: Dubai Airport issues warning over fabricated, digitally altered videos circulating online
stories.summary: Dubai International Airport has issued a warning regarding digitally manipulated videos falsely depicting incidents at the airport. Authorities urge the public to rely on official updates and refrain from sharing unverified content, emphasizing potential legal consequences under UAE regulations for spreading misinformation.

stories.title: Day 5: US assets hit across Mid-East; Israel launches fresh strikes on Iran, Lebanon
stories.summary: Intense fighting grips the Middle East as Iran and the US-Israeli alliance escalate conflict. Tehran faces sustained strikes on military and nuclear sites, retaliating with attacks on regional US assets and Israel. Casualties mount on both sides, with evacuations underway for foreign nationals. The future leadership of Iran remains uncertain amidst the escalating violence.

stories.title: 'Ashes to ashes, dust to dust': Inside Masaan Holi at Manikarnika Ghat
stories.summary: Banaras' Masaan Holi offers a unique, contemplative celebration with sacred ashes from cremation pyres, unlike the riot of colours elsewhere. Rooted in Shaivite traditions, it symbolizes life's cyclical nature and confronts mortality. While social media has amplified its spectacle, the ritual's profound, existential encounter remains, urging immersion beyond filtered frames.

stories.title: 'Most people we had in mind are dead': Donald Trump after Khamenei assassination
stories.summary: US President Trump stated that "most of the people we had in mind are dead" following reported Iranian leadership casualties in Operation Epic Fury. He claimed a "third wave" of strikes has crippled Iran's capabilities, asserting the US acted preemptively to prevent an Iranian attack. Trump highlighted significant Iranian losses and a desire for immunity among remaining figures.

stories.title: 'We've just begun': US says it has bombed over 2,000 targets in Iran - top developments
stories.summary: Israel and the United States have launched a major joint operation against Iran. The campaign involves extensive strikes targeting Iranian military and nuclear facilities. Iran has retaliated, hitting US diplomatic sites and energy infrastructure across the region. The conflict has spread, causing casualties and displacement. Global energy prices are rising as the Strait of Hormuz remains a point of tension.

stories.title: 6L kids born with anomalies per year but no national registry to track them
stories.summary: India faces a critical gap in tracking nearly 6 lakh babies born annually with congenital anomalies, as these conditions increasingly contribute to child mortality. To address this, Smile Train India and Birth Defects Research Foundation launched BIND, advocating for a National Birth Anomalies Registry to improve data, identify risk factors, and guide health planning for better prevention and care.

stories.title: Ravi Shankar to head Lok Sabha privileges panel
stories.summary: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla has formed the committee of privileges. This important panel will examine complaints of breach of privilege. BJP MP Ravi Shankar Prasad will lead the 15-member committee. The panel includes members from both the ruling NDA and opposition parties. A complaint against Rahul Gandhi is pending Speaker's decision.

stories.title: Middle East tensions: Iran's $20k drones take on defences of US worth $4 million
stories.summary: The Iran war has quickly become attritional, with Iranian drone attacks depleting US and partner weapon stockpiles. While Patriot missiles are effective, their high cost against cheap drones highlights a critical resource challenge. The conflict's outcome may hinge on which side exhausts its munitions first.

stories.title: Top Iran official vows attacks on tankers using Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: An Iranian military official threatened to "set on fire" ships in the Strait of Hormuz, a vital oil transit route. This warning follows US and Israeli strikes, leading most shipping companies to halt passage through the strait. The reduced traffic raises concerns about oil supply disruptions and potential price hikes for consumers.

stories.title: Iran's strategy: Expand war, increase cost, outlast Donald Trump
stories.summary: Iran's survival hinges on escalating regional conflict, aiming to raise the cost for the US through attacks on oil infrastructure and shipping. This strategy seeks to pressure President Trump into withdrawing by disrupting global economies and exhausting enemy defenses. Analysts believe Iran is prepared for a prolonged struggle, testing international will.

stories.title: US, Israel attacks Iran: AIMPLB urges UN to take steps for ceasefire
stories.summary: The All India Muslim Personal Law Board has strongly condemned the US-Israel's actions against Iran, calling for immediate international intervention to secure a ceasefire. The board expressed sorrow over the reported martyrdom of Iran's supreme leader, Ayatollah Khamenei, and highlighted that targeting leadership and advocating regime change violates international law.

stories.title: Under pressure, Karnataka to revise internal quota of SC communities
stories.summary: Karnataka's Congress government is reconsidering its decision to fill 56,432 government posts without internal reservation for Scheduled Castes. Following pressure from SC communities and ministers, the cabinet will discuss introducing pro-rata internal reservation within the existing 15% SC quota.

stories.title: Nitish's son Nishant set for political launch ahead of Rajya Sabha election
stories.summary: Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar's son, Nishant Kumar, is reportedly set to enter politics, marking a shift from his father's stance against dynastic succession. This move comes amid growing internal party pressure and concerns about leadership transition, with Nishant seen as a potential link to traditional JDU supporters.

stories.title: BJP to contest 2 Bihar Rajya Sabha seats, Nitin Nabin to make Parliament debut
stories.summary: Move To Cement Party President's Presence In National Politics

stories.title: Adin Ross sister Madeline Ross dies at 36 in Broward County Florida, cause of death pending
stories.summary: Madeline Ross, sister of streamer Adin Ross, died on January 15 in Broward County, Florida, at age 36. The Broward County Medical Examiner confirmed the news to TMZ. The cause of death is still pending. Madeline lived a private life. Adin Ross remains one of the world’s most followed streamers despite past controversies.

stories.title: “Connecting dots” Journalist defends Candace Owens amid Bride of Charlie controversy, claims Charlie Kirk mystery will be solved
stories.summary: Journalist Elizabeth Lane publicly backed Candace Owens after the release of the fourth Bride of Charlie episode. Owens continues to question the circumstances around Charlie Kirk’s death and has made claims about Erika Kirk’s upbringing. Lane believes the case will be solved. No new official updates have been announced by authorities regarding the investigation.

stories.title: 'Khamenei supported J&K rebels': BJP hits out at Sonia Gandhi
stories.summary: The BJP criticized Sonia Gandhi's remarks on the government's response to Iran's leader's death, recalling his past support for secessionist forces in Kashmir. The party stated that diplomacy requires restraint and respect for sovereignty, not appeasement. They also pointed out the UPA's silence on Muammar Gaddafi's death in 2011.

stories.title: Data centres new target in Iran conflict; 3 Amazon units hit by drones in UAE, Bahrain
stories.summary: Iran has targeted three Amazon data centers in the UAE and Bahrain with drone strikes, causing widespread disruptions to cloud services and banking across West Asia. This marks a significant escalation, with critical infrastructure now including data centers. Repairs are expected to be lengthy, impacting regional markets and air travel.

stories.title: Parliament must debate 'dissonance' in foreign policy: Congress MP Sonia Gandhi
stories.summary: Congress leaders Sonia and Rahul Gandhi criticized PM Modi's government for its "silence" on the attack on Iran, calling it a "tacit endorsement." They questioned India's foreign policy direction and its standing in the world, especially concerning the "Global South," urging a return to India's core values of sovereignty and peace.

stories.title: Was the US attack on Iran predicted just days before? Ex-CIA officer John Kiriakou's shocking warning
stories.summary: Following Operation Epic Fury, the United States and Israel launched sweeping strikes on Iran’s missile and nuclear infrastructure, an assault that killed Iran’s Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, and triggered widespread regional retaliation. The escalation came just days after former CIA officer John Kiriakou publicly warned that Washington had already decided to attack, a claim that now appears to have foreshadowed one of the most consequential confrontations in years.

stories.title: PM Modi calls for export push, puts biopharma at centre stage
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has signaled a strategic shift in India's export policy, moving from cost competitiveness to quality-driven growth. He urged industries to scale up research, adopt global standards, and align with emerging supply chains to become a trusted manufacturing partner in a reshaped global trade landscape.

stories.title: Middle East tensions: Have critical stakes in Gulf, will act in national interest, says government
stories.summary: India expresses deep anxiety over the escalating West Asia conflict, highlighting the critical stakes for nearly one crore Indian nationals in the Gulf and the potential economic repercussions. The Ministry of External Affairs strongly condemned attacks on merchant shipping, noting the loss of Indian lives and emphasizing the need for restraint and dialogue.

stories.title: Iran crisis: PM Modi talks to leaders of Qatar, Oman, Kuwait
stories.summary: Prime Minister Modi engaged with leaders of Qatar, Oman, and Kuwait, condemning Iranian attacks and reaffirming India's commitment to regional peace. These discussions, completing talks with all GCC nations, highlighted India's focus on protecting its diaspora and ensuring stability. Modi stressed dialogue and diplomacy for restoring harmony and thanked leaders for their support to the Indian community.

stories.title: Pahalgam case: NIA seeks China's help to trace GoPro cam info
stories.summary: A special NIA court has issued a letter rogatory to China seeking assistance in tracing the supply chain of a GoPro camera seized in the Pahalgam terror attack case. The camera, activated in China, is crucial for establishing pre-attack reconnaissance and the movement of the Pakistani terror module.

stories.title: After 41 years, Supreme Court finds accused guilty but waives prison term
stories.summary: Curtains Come Down On 777 Foreign-Made Wristwatches Smuggling Case

stories.title: ‘I’m not happy with the UK’: Donald Trump criticizes Keir Starmer over military access
stories.summary: President Trump has sharply criticized UK Prime Minister Starmer for initially withholding UK bases for US strikes on Iran, stating the "special relationship" has weakened. Starmer later agreed to limited defensive use of two bases after a UK base in Cyprus was attacked. The UK emphasizes acting on a legal basis and in its national interest, recalling Iraq war lessons.

stories.title: US, Israel attacks Iran: Scheduled, charter flights to be used for repatriation
stories.summary: India is actively working to repatriate thousands of its citizens stranded in West Asian countries like the UAE and Qatar. The government is utilizing a combination of charter and scheduled flights, with airlines warned against fare hikes. This effort follows a high-level review of the West Asia crisis.

stories.title: '4 days without a plan': Trump admin slammed as it issues helpline numbers for Americans stranded in Middle East
West Asia crisis: 38 Indian ships stuck in Persian Gulf; 3 sailors dead
stories.summary: Thirty-eight Indian-flagged ships, carrying crude and LNG with nearly 1,100 seafarers, are stranded in the Persian Gulf due to the West Asia conflict. Three Indian sailors died and one was injured on foreign-flagged vessels in recent attacks off Oman. Shipping authorities are prioritizing seafarer safety and maritime asset security.

stories.title: 'Hearts broken beyond words': Indian-origin Savitha Shan's parents breaks silence after daughter killed in Austin shooting
GoPro trail in Pahalgam terror attack leads to Chinese city, court allows NIA to seek Beijing help
stories.summary: NIA has requested China's assistance to identify the buyer of a GoPro camera, crucial evidence in a Lashkar-e-Taiba attack. Activated in Dongguan, China, the camera's origin is vital for tracing terrorist reconnaissance and operational links. This move highlights international cooperation efforts in combating terror.

stories.title: Bharat Mandapam AI summit protest: Youth Congress president Uday Bhanu Chib and others released from Tihar jail
stories.summary: Indian Youth Congress president Uday Bhanu Chib has been released from Tihar jail after being granted bail. He asserted that the Congress and its youth wing will continue their opposition to the India-US deal, claiming it harms farmers. Chib was arrested for his alleged role in a protest at Bharat Mandapam.

stories.title: Kash Patel fires FBI agents with Iran expertise days before Tehran strike, also ousts members who investigated Trump: Report
stories.summary: FBI Director Kash Patel reportedly fired a dozen agents from an elite counter-espionage unit, CI-12, which specializes in threats from Iran. These firings occurred amid an investigation into Donald Trump's handling of classified documents and shortly before Trump launched bombing strikes on Iran.

stories.title: 'Craziest experience': Trump adviser, Dallas dog walker rescued from Middle East on private jet while thousands stranded amid Iran crisis
Texas bar shooting: Suspect Ndiaga Diagne previously posted misogynistic, antisemitic and racist remarks, praised Islamic revolution — report claims
stories.summary: A deadly shootout erupted at Buford's Backyard Beer Garden after a man, identified as Ndiaga Diagne, opened fire. Authorities are investigating the incident, potentially linked to recent US and Israeli actions in Iran. Diagne's online activity revealed a history of hateful rhetoric, including antisemitic and anti-Christian sentiments, raising concerns about his motives.

stories.title: Japan’s ‘snow monsters’: The frozen giants of Zao that only appear for weeks and locals say they’re slowly disappearing
'Everything knocked out': Trump on Iran strikes, says he 'might have forced Israel's hand'
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump asserted that Iran's military capabilities have been significantly degraded, with "everything knocked out" following a joint operation with Israel that resulted in the death of Supreme Leader Khamenei. He suggested this action preempted an imminent Iranian attack, stating, "I might have forced Israel's hand. He further called the Iran regime "evil"

stories.title: Kristi Noem under fire for $300 million DHS jet spending amid border funding fight
stories.summary: Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem faces criticism for allegedly spending over $300 million on three private luxury jets, diverting funds intended for border security. The purchase, including a Boeing 737 Max 8, has drawn sharp condemnation from Democrats and watchdog groups, who question the necessity and legality of the expenditure amid budget constraints.

stories.title: US Air Force sergeant in uniform makes video ranting against US. Who is Melissa Mece?
After 'solving' eight wars, Trump gives ten interviews to explain initiating ninth: I got Khamenei before he got me
stories.summary: President Trump offered multiple justifications for the air campaign against Iran, including a preemptive strike against its supreme leader. He cited intelligence of assassination plots, election interference, and an imminent nuclear threat, though evidence remains unrevealed. Trump's strategy aims to control the narrative, presenting varied reasons to different outlets.

stories.title: Congress announces first list for Assam polls; Gaurav Gogoi to contest from Jorhat
stories.summary: The AICC released its first list of 42 candidates for the Assam assembly elections, creating friction with the Raijor Dal. Prominent Congress leaders like Gaurav Gogoi and Debabrata Saikia are among those nominated. The move has upset Raijor Dal, which was in advanced alliance talks with Congress and sought specific seats.

stories.title: Assam Assembly election: Congress releases first list of 42 candidates; fields Gaurav Gogoi in Jorhat
stories.summary: The Congress party has unveiled its initial list of 42 candidates for the upcoming Assam Assembly elections, launching its campaign early. Key figures like Gaurav Gogoi and Debabrata Saikia will contest from Jorhat and Nazira respectively, as the party seeks to regain power after a significant hiatus.

stories.title: Israel-Iran war halts egg exports from Namakkal; losses estimated at Rs 5 five crore daily
stories.summary: Namakkal, one of India’s major egg production and trading hubs, regularly supplies large quantities to overseas buyers. But the Middle East conflict has left exporters struggling to meet commitments and manage inventory.

stories.title: Small plane makes emergency landing in frigid Hudson River and the 2 people aboard swim to safety
'They died for Iran or Israel': Megyn Kelly’s remark on fallen US soldiers sparks online backlash
'If only she stayed in the safety of India': Racist trolling over Indian origin of Texas victim Savitha Shan
CM Rekha Gupta inaugurates NDMC's two-day flower festival
Irony much? This Jewish British billionaire wants to move to Germany over UK's ‘anti-Jew’ stance
stories.summary: A prominent Jewish billionaire, Sir Michael Moritz, born in Britain, is seeking German citizenship. He feels Britain has become an uncomfortable place for Jews today. Moritz believes Germany's civic identity is built on confronting its past. This move highlights growing concerns within Britain's Jewish community about social cohesion and belonging.

stories.title: ‘Israel is the boss’: Ex-MAGA ally Nick Fuentes slams Trump over Iran strike, urges supporters to abandon Republicans
stories.summary: Far-right commentator Nick Fuentes is calling on his supporters to reject President Donald Trump. Fuentes claims Trump made statements about soldiers dying and asserts that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu holds significant power over American decisions. He alleges that Jewish people control America's financial and political leverage.

stories.title: Indian wedding caterer found guilty of sexually abusing child in Australia, sent to jail for only 13 months
Evening news wrap: Israel launches ground offensive in Lebanon; why India is silent over Khamenei's demise & more
US-Iran war: PM Modi speaks to leaders of Oman and Kuwait, discusses security of Indians
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke with the Sultan of Oman and the Crown Prince of Kuwait. Discussions focused on escalating Middle East tensions and the safety of Indians in these nations. India is actively engaging with Gulf partners. The nation prioritizes the well-being of its citizens abroad. India calls for restraint and de-escalation in the region.

stories.title: Ayatollah's son Mojtaba Khamenei elected as Iran's next Supreme Leader: Report
